scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
It's been a long
time, my friend. With
your help, my wife has
gotten much better.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
好久不见，我的朋友。
多亏了你的帮助，
我妻子的身体
已经好多了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Once again, I want to
thank you for what you've
done for me. Please drop
by anytime whenever you
come visit my town.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
再次感谢
你为我所做的一切。
如果你来我的城镇，
请随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Oh, welcome.
So did you bring
everything that
I've asked you?
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
哦，欢迎。
那么，你带齐了
我让你准备的东西吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 不，还没准备好。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Let me check the items
that you brought before
I give you an Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
让我检查一下
你带来的物品，
然后再给你
神之金属。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Good, you brought
everything! Now let me
give you this Oridecon.
I'm sorry that I can't offer
you much more than this.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
很好，你带齐了！
现在给你这块神之金属。
抱歉，我没法
给你更多了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Alright then,
adventurer. I hope
you travel in safety.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
那么，冒险者。
祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Hmmm, it seems you're
carrying too many things
with you. Shouldn't you
store some of your items
in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
嗯...？
你身上带的东西
好像太多了。
难道你不该先把
一些物品存进卡普拉仓库吗？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Hm...?
You're missing some
things. Let me tell you
what you need to bring
once again so that I can
give you 1 Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
嗯...？
你少带了一些东西。
让我再告诉你一次
你需要带什么，
这样我才能给你
1块神之金属。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
40 Large Jellopy,
10 Emveretarcon,
3 Coal and
10 Zargon.
Please don't
forget this.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
40个巨大杰勒比结晶，
10个强化武器金属-级数二，
3块煤炭和
10个刹勒空结晶。
请不要忘记这些。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Oh, alright.
Let me remind
you of what you
need to trade for
1 Oridecon in
case you've forgotten.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
哦，好吧。
让我提醒你一下
交换1块神之金属
所需的物品，
以防你忘记了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
40 Large Jellopy,
10 Emveretarcon,
3 Coal and
10 Zargon.
Come back
whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
40个巨大杰勒比结晶，
10个强化武器金属-级数二，
3块煤炭和
10个刹勒空结晶。
准备好了随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Recently, we've had some
tunnel cave-ins which resulted
in miner casualties. We're having
a harder time working in the
mines now that we're even
lower on manpower.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
最近，我们发生了一些
隧道坍塌事故，
导致矿工伤亡。
现在人手更少，
在矿里工作更难了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
What's really suspicious
is that it seems something
has been making the tunnels
collapse on purpose. Some of
us believe it's because we've
angered the master of the cave.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
真正可疑的是，
似乎有什么东西
故意让隧道坍塌。
我们中的一些人认为，
这是因为我们
惹怒了洞穴的主人。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
The tunnel accident
is still fresh in my mind.
It seems that there are
more ^FF0000Cave Master^000000 sightings
when the tunnels started
to inexplicably collapse.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
隧道事故
还历历在目。
似乎当隧道
开始莫名其妙地坍塌时，
^FF0000洞穴主人^000000
出现的次数也更多了。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I was off duty when
the accident happened.
Still, I hear the only survivor
went crazy and disappeared
somewhere. The poor bastard...
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
事故发生时
我正好下班。
但我听说唯一的幸存者
疯了，然后
不知去向。可怜的家伙...

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
You're...
You're just as
bad off as I am!
I feel so sorry for you
that I'd give you some
zeny if I could spare it...
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
你...
你的处境
和我一样糟糕！
我很同情你，
如果我能匀出一些
Zeny，真想给你...

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Hmm...?
I'm sorry, but
I don't think I have
the luxury of chatting
at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
嗯...？
抱歉，但我现在
恐怕没有
闲聊的余裕。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
My wife was seriously
injured when she was
working with me in the
mine when it collapsed.
It's agonizing, wondering
if she'll be okay or not.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
我妻子和我一起在
矿里工作时，
隧道坍塌了，
她受了重伤。
不知道她能不能好起来，
这让我很痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Luckily no one
was killed, but my
wife is... ^333333*S-Sob*^000000
I'm sorry, but I need
to be alone right now...
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
幸好没有人
丧命，但我妻子...
^333333*抽泣*^000000
抱歉，我现在
需要一个人静静...

scripts.text: I can help you.
scripts.translation: 我可以帮你。

scripts.text: Okay...
scripts.translation: 好的...

scripts.text: An accident?
scripts.translation: 是意外吗？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Are you serious?!
Thank you, thank you so much!
A-as you can see, I'm not doing
so well financially. But I've got to get my wife to a hospital.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
你是认真的吗？！
太感谢你了，真的非常感谢！
如你所见，我现在的经济状况很糟糕。但我必须把我妻子送到医院去。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
And since I've got to
take of her myself,
I haven't been able to work.
I don't know what I should do.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
因为我要亲自照顾她，
所以我一直没能工作。
我不知道该怎么办才好。

scripts.text: Then how can I help?
scripts.translation: 那我该怎么帮你？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Well, to be frank,
I'm in dire need of zeny.
It costs 1,000 zeny to cover
her medical expenses and
food for just one day.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
说实话，
我急需Zeny。
仅仅一天的医疗费和伙食费
就需要1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Help Him.
scripts.translation: 帮助他

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Hmmm, it seems you're
carrying too many things
with you. Shouldn't you
store some of your items
in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
嗯...？
你身上带的东西
好像太多了。
难道你不该先把
一些物品存进卡普拉仓库吗？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Oh...!
Thank you, you
can't imagine how
grateful I am! I never
believed that I'd meet
someone as kind as you.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
哦...！
谢谢你，你无法想象
我有多感激！我从未想过
能遇到像你这样善良的人。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Other adventurers have
also been helping me, so
with all of your help, my wife
has been getting better.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
其他冒险者
也在帮助我，
多亏了大家的帮助，
我妻子的病情正在好转。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I would like to give
you a small present
as a token of my gratitute.
If you would, please take this.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
我想送你一份小礼物
以表达我的感激之情。
如果你不介意的话，请收下这个。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I've been keeping these
kinds of metals since I was
sure they'd be more useful
to someone other than me.
Hopefully, you'll find this ore
useful in one way or another.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
我一直留着这些金属，
因为我觉得它们对别人
可能比对我更有用。
希望这些矿石能在某方面对你有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
If I were still
working, I'd try my
best to pay you back.
But my current situation
doesn't really allow it...
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
如果我还在工作，
我会尽力报答你的。
但我目前的情况
实在不允许...

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Still, I'd be happy
to trade you 1 Oridecon
if you can bring me some
items. How does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
不过，如果你能给我一些物品，
我很乐意用1个神之金属与你交换。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Would you bring me
40 Large Jellopy,
10 Emveretarcon,
3 Coal and
10 Zargon?
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
你能给我带来
40个巨大杰勒比结晶，
10个强化武器金属-级数二，
3个煤炭和
10个刹勒空结晶吗？

scripts.text: Sure~!
scripts.translation: 没问题~！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
Great...!
Now I need to go
take care of my wife.
Come back when you
gather everything I've
asked you to bring.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
太好了...！
现在我要去照顾我妻子了。
等你集齐我让你带的东西后，
再回来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I see.
Well, I understand
that adventurers don't
stay in one place for
very long. Once again,
thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
我明白了。
我知道冒险者
不会在一个地方停留太久。
再次感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
But please take
this small gift
as a token of
my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
但请收下
这份小礼物，
以表达我的感激之情。

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
I understand.
I'm sorry that I've
asked so much of you.
But please understand
that I'm desperate...
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
我理解。
抱歉，我向你提出了
这么多要求。
但请理解，
我是走投无路了...

scripts.text:
[Cavitar]
You're...
You're heartless!
^666666*Sob...*^000000
Can't you see that I'm
poor and need help?!
scripts.translation:
[卡维塔尔]
你...
你真没良心！
^666666*抽泣*^000000
你难道看不出我
很穷，需要帮助吗？！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh hello hello~
It's been a long
time since we've talked,
you cutie adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
哎呀，你好呀~
好久没聊了，
可爱的小冒险者~

scripts.text: So... You're a chef.
scripts.translation: 所以...你是厨师。

scripts.text: Yes, I tried my best.
scripts.translation: 是的，我尽力了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
You're a chef.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以...
你是厨师。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
That's right, it's
what I do for business.
Now, as for what I do for
^EEA9B8pleasure^000000, well, please don't
hesitate to ask, sugar honey~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
没错，这是我的工作。
至于我为了^EEA9B8快乐^000000做的事嘛，
尽管开口就好，亲爱的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Only continuous effort will lead you to success. I guess that means you've learned your lesson, sugar honey~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
只有持续的努力才能带来成功。看来你已经吸取教训了，亲爱的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh, I was going to give
you a little something,
but you've carrying too
many things. Why don't
you put some of it away
in your Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
哦，我本来想送你点东西，
但你身上带的东西太多了。
为什么不把一些放进卡普拉仓库呢？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
I had these lying
around, so why don't
you take them, sugar
honey? They're not very
pricey, but they're useful
in doing some smithing.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
这些是我随手放着的，
拿去用吧，亲爱的？
虽然不值什么钱，
但在锻造时很有用。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Alright then~
Hope you enjoy
your Mini Furances
...Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
那么~
希望你能享受
你的迷你佛朗西...
呵呵~

scripts.text:

[乌维]

scripts.translation:

上次拜托你的小事怎么样了？

那6个巨大杰勒比结晶？

scripts.text: There you go.
scripts.translation: 给你。

scripts.text: I want to quit.

scripts.text: Can I do it later?

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch was originally
built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
艾音布罗克最初是为了支持
艾音贝赫的采矿工作而建立的。
因为那里地方狭小且人口密集，
没有空间在那里建造矿石精炼厂。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Since Einbroch used to be
an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
既然艾音布罗克以前是一片空地，
非常适合建工厂。这是我祖父很久以前告诉我的。
总之，艾音布罗克很快发展成了一个主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now people think that this
city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.
See that rampart over there?
It doesn't connect to Einbech at all! No protection for them...
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
现在人们认为这座城市
从未被规划为仅仅是艾音贝赫的延伸。
看到那边的城墙了吗？
它根本没有与艾音贝赫相连！对他们没有任何保护...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's like the government
lost all interest in Einbech.
Even the miners there have
been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
这就像政府完全失去了
对艾音贝赫的兴趣一样。
甚至那里的矿工也搬到这里
在工厂工作。但更多的人并没有让这座城市变得更热闹。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch may look modern
and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
艾音布罗克现在看起来可能很现代、很刺激，
但很快你就会发现那里没有温暖和生机的迹象。
所以... 老了以后千万别住在这里。

scripts.text: Then why are you here?
scripts.translation: 那你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: But I like the city life~
scripts.translation: 但我喜欢城市生活~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

I've been waiting for
someone. But... It looks
like that person won't be
coming back anyway.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]

我一直在等一个人。但是... 看起来那个人
反正也不会再回来了。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oooh, but let's not talk
about that. Next time you
drop by, we'll talk about
something more fun, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
噢噢，但我们别谈那个了。
下次你来的时候，我们聊点更有趣的事，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Big cities can be nice,
but you never get to enjoy
the sensation of stepping
barefoot through the grass,
or the magnificent sight of
the shining stars at night.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
大城市虽然不错，
但你永远无法享受赤脚踩在草地上的感觉，
或者夜晚璀璨星空的壮丽景色。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
And the people who live
in the cities can be so
uptight! I've known more
than a few who look down
on people from smaller towns.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
而且住在城市里的人
往往很拘谨！我认识不少
瞧不起小城镇居民的人。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's sad to see some
people will always be
that ignorant. I... I just
can't believe those people
can be sooo close minded!
scripts.translation:
[乌维]

我... 我简直不敢相信那些人
可以那么狭隘！

^666666*Titter*^000000 Next time you drop

you want, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
哦...？
随时欢迎你来找我玩，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch was originally
built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
艾音布罗克最初是为了支持
艾音贝赫的采矿工作而建立的。
因为那里地方狭小且人口密集，
没有空间在那里建造矿石精炼厂。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Since Einbroch used to be
an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
既然艾音布罗克以前是一片空地，
非常适合建工厂。这是我祖父很久以前告诉我的。
总之，艾音布罗克很快发展成了一个主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now people think that this
city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.
See that rampart over there?
It doesn't connect to Einbech at all! No protection for them...
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
现在人们认为这座城市
从未被规划为仅仅是艾音贝赫的延伸。
看到那边的城墙了吗？
它根本没有与艾音贝赫相连！对他们没有任何保护...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's like the government
lost all interest in Einbech.
Even the miners there have
been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
这就像政府完全失去了
对艾音贝赫的兴趣一样。
甚至那里的矿工也搬到这里
在工厂工作。但更多的人并没有让这座城市变得更热闹。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch may look modern
and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
艾音布罗克现在看起来可能很现代、很刺激，
但很快你就会发现那里没有温暖和生机的迹象。
所以... 老了以后千万别住在这里。

scripts.text: Then why are you here?
scripts.translation: 那你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: But I like the city life~
scripts.translation: 但我喜欢城市生活~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, sugar honey,
I've been waiting for someone. But... It looks like that person won't be coming back anyway.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
哎呀，亲爱的，
我一直在等一个人。但是... 看起来那个人
反正也不会再回来了。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oooh, but let's not talk about that. Next time you drop by, we'll talk about something more fun, 'kay? Buhbye~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
哎呀，我们别聊这个了。下次你来的时候，我们聊点更有趣的话题，好不好？拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, big cities are nice, but you never get to enjoy the sensation of stepping barefoot through the grass, or the clear sight of the stars at night.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
大城市确实不错，但你永远无法享受赤脚踩在草地上的感觉，或者在夜晚仰望清澈星空的惬意。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
And the people who live in cities can be so uptight! I've known more than a few who look down on people who live in smaller towns.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
而且住在城里的人总是那么拘谨！我认识不少瞧不起住在小城镇的人。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's sad to see some people will always be that ignorant. I... I just can't believe people can be sooo close minded!
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
看到有些人总是如此无知，真让人难过。我...我简直不敢相信人们可以这么狭隘！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh...!
I'm sorry, I guess I went a little overboard. ^666666*Titter*^000000 Next time you drop by, we'll talk about something more fun, 'kay? Buhbye~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
噢...！
抱歉，我好像有点说得太多了。^666666*咯咯笑*^000000 下次你来的时候，我们聊点更有趣的话题，好不好？拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Cooking utensils?
Well, they're usually
made out of ^0000FFJubilee^000000,
a crystallization dropped
from mineral monsters.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
厨具？
嗯，它们通常是用^0000FF杰勒比结晶^000000制成的，
那是矿石魔掉落的结晶。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Jubilee is too soft
to make weapons, but
it conducts heat very well
so it's perfect for making
cooking utensils! *Tee hee~*
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
杰勒比结晶太软了，
不适合做武器，但它导热性非常好，
所以非常适合制作厨具！*嘻嘻~*

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
That reminds me...
I need to make some new cooking utensils soon. Would you do me a favor and let me have some of your materials? Pretty pleeeeeease~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
这让我想起...
我最近需要制作一些新的厨具。你能帮个忙，把一些材料给我吗？拜托拜托~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
If you don't mind,
would you please give me
30 ^0000FFJubilee^000000 and 4 ^0000FFLarge Jellopy^000000.
Then, I'll trade you 1 Coal for all of those. How does it sound?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
如果不介意的话，
请给我30个^0000FF杰勒比结晶^000000和4个^0000FF巨大杰勒比结晶^000000。
作为交换，我会给你1个煤炭。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Hooray!
Thank you
^EEA9B8soooo^000000 much!
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
太棒了！
非常感谢
^EEA9B8你^000000！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Hmmm...?
You don't have
enough of them?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
嗯...？
你的材料不够吗？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh well, don't
worry. You can take
your time and bring
that stuff whenever
 you can, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
没关系，别担心。
你可以慢慢收集，
什么时候准备好了再带给我，好不好？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
I understand.
You might not have all
that Jubilee and Large Jellopy
I'm asking for at the moment,
anyway. But if you do get them, would visit me again, cutie?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
我理解。
你现在可能没有我要求的所有杰勒比结晶和巨大杰勒比结晶。
但如果你以后收集到了，能再来找我吗，亲爱的？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh...?
Well, feel
free to visit
me whenever
you want, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
哦...？
随时欢迎你来找我玩，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oooh...!
Congratulations!
You finally became
a cutie MasterSmith!
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
噢...！
恭喜！
你终于成为了
一位可爱的神工匠！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Mmmm...
I know!
Let's celebrate!
Here sugar honey,
have some of these
cookies I just baked~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
嗯...
我知道！
让我们庆祝一下吧！
亲爱的，尝尝我刚刚烤的这些饼干~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Okay, enjoy!
I hope you have
a good time smithing!
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
好的，尽情享用吧！
祝你锻造愉快！

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Hmmm?
Oh, it's you~
I'm sorry, I was
just thinking about
something but now I just
lost my train of thought.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
嗯？
噢，是你呀~
抱歉，我刚才在想事情，
结果一下子忘了要说什么了。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
What was I going
to say? Hmm, I can't
quite remember. Oh well,
I'll see you later, cutie~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
我刚才想说什么来着？嗯，我有点记不清了。算了，
下次见，亲爱的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Hm...?
I never forget a face,
but somehow I feel like
we've met somewhere before...
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
嗯...？
我从不忘记一张脸，
但不知为何我觉得我们好像在哪儿见过...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Ah...!
I have it!
{0}!
Yes, now I remember you.
Decided to transcend, eh?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
啊...！
我想起来了！
{0}！
是的，我想起来了。
决定转职了吗？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
What brings to
me, you ^EEA9B8naughty boy^000000?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
是什么风把你吹来了，^EEA9B8小调皮^000000？

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
What brings to
me, you ^EEA9B8naughty girl^000000?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
是什么风把你吹来了，^EEA9B8小调皮^000000？

scripts.text:

Ah, hello again,
cutie adventurer.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
啊，又见面了，可爱的冒险者。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Ask about Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 询问艾音布罗克

scripts.translation: 那你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: I won't. Thanks for the advice.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢你的建议。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, I have some
precious memories of
this place. Once, there was
a man who lived here who
was just like a father to me.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
嗯，我对这个地方有着珍贵的回忆。
曾经，这里住着一位老人，他对我来说就像父亲一样。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh, but I'm sure that
you don't want to hear
about that. Next time you
drop by, we'll talk about
something more fun, 'kay?
Buhbye for now, cutie~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
噢，不过我猜你不想听这些。
下次再来时，我们再聊点更有趣的话题，好吗？
那先拜拜了，亲爱的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Oh, that is such
a good decision,
sugar honey! Oh, you
cutie adventurers are
so precious, so lovable.
^333333*Tee hee hee~*^000000
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
噢，真是个好决定，甜心！
噢，你们这些可爱的冒险者真是太珍贵、太讨人喜欢了。
^333333*嘻嘻嘻~*^000000

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, that was
a fun talk. Come
back and visit, 'kay?
I'll miss you until
the next time~
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
嗯，聊得很开心。
记得再来玩哦。
在那之前我会想你的~

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Ooh, cooking!
So what did you
want to ask me...?
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
噢，烹饪！
那么你想问我什么呢...

scripts.text: Heart
scripts.translation: 心

scripts.text: Ingredients
scripts.translation: 食材

scripts.text: Skills
scripts.translation: 技巧

scripts.text: Tools
scripts.translation: 工具

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Ah, heart. Just like forging,
you need passion and desire
to create something special.
Every smith and cook knows that
you can do anything if you have
the will and the commitment.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
啊，心。就像锻造一样，
你需要热情和渴望才能创造出特别的东西。
每个铁匠和厨师都知道，
只要有决心和坚持，就能做到任何事。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, that's all
I really have to
say about that. But
come back and chat
whenever you please.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
嗯，关于这个话题，我其实就这么多话。
但随时欢迎回来聊天。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, that's all
I really have to
say about that. But
come back and chat
whenever you please.
...Ho ho~
scripts.translation:

我大概就这么多要说的了。
但随时欢迎你来找我聊天。
...呵呵~

scripts.text: Talk about Einbroch.

scripts.text: Ask him to forge a Weapon.

scripts.text: Talk about Cooking.

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch was originally
built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
艾音布罗克最初是为了支持
艾音贝赫的采矿工作而建立的。
因为那里地方狭小且人口密集，
没有空间在那里建造矿石精炼厂。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Since Einbroch used to be
an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
既然艾音布罗克以前是一片空地，
非常适合建工厂。这是我祖父很久以前告诉我的。
总之，艾音布罗克很快发展成了一个主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now people think that this
city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.
See that rampart over there?
It doesn't connect to Einbech at all! No protection for them...
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
现在人们认为这座城市
从未被规划为仅仅是艾音贝赫的延伸。
看到那边的城墙了吗？
它根本没有与艾音贝赫相连！对他们没有任何保护...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's like the government
lost all interest in Einbech.
Even the miners there have
been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
这就像政府完全失去了
对艾音贝赫的兴趣一样。
甚至那里的矿工也搬到这里
在工厂工作。但更多的人并没有让这座城市变得更热闹。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch may look modern
and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
艾音布罗克现在看起来可能很现代、很刺激，
但很快你就会发现那里没有温暖和生机的迹象。
所以... 老了以后千万别住在这里。

scripts.text: Then why are you here?
scripts.translation: 那你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: I won't. Thanks for the advice.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢你的建议。

precious memories of

a man who lived here who
was just like a father to me.

built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.

没有空间在那里建造矿石精炼厂。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.

总之，艾音布罗克很快发展成了一个主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.

[Uwe]

lost all interest in Einbech.

been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.

在工厂工作。但更多的人并没有让这座城市变得更热闹。

[Uwe]
Einbroch may look modern
and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.

scripts.text: Um, isn't this a forge?

you haven't been here

scripts.translation:

修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国里
最优雅的铁匠，

scripts.text:

I help you, you
adooooooooorable

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Talk about Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 聊聊艾音布罗克。

scripts.text: Ask him to forge a Weapon.
scripts.translation: 请他锻造武器。

scripts.text: Master, I want to learn cooking.
scripts.translation: 师父，我想学烹饪。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch was originally
built to support Einbech's
mining efforts. Because it's
small and crowded with people,
there's no room to build the ore refining factories over there.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
艾音布罗克最初是为了支持
艾音贝赫的采矿工作而建立的。
因为那里地方狭小且人口密集，
没有空间在那里建造矿石精炼厂。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Since Einbroch used to be
an empty lot, it was perfect
for building factories. That's
what my grandfather told me a
long time ago. Anyway, Einbroch quickly grew into a major city.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
既然艾音布罗克以前是一片空地，
非常适合建工厂。这是我祖父很久以前告诉我的。
总之，艾音布罗克很快发展成了一个主要城市。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Now people think that this
city was never planned to be
just an extension of Einbech.
See that rampart over there?
It doesn't connect to Einbech at all! No protection for them...
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
现在人们认为这座城市
从未被规划为仅仅是艾音贝赫的延伸。
看到那边的城墙了吗？
它根本没有与艾音贝赫相连！对他们没有任何保护...

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
It's like the government
lost all interest in Einbech.
Even the miners there have
been moving here to work in 
the factories. But more people hasn't made this city more lively.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
这就像政府完全失去了
对艾音贝赫的兴趣一样。
甚至那里的矿工也搬到这里
在工厂工作。但更多的人并没有让这座城市变得更热闹。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Einbroch may look modern
and exciting now, but soon
you'll see that there's no sign
of warmth or life. So... Just don't live here in your old age.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
艾音布罗克现在看起来可能很现代、很刺激，
但很快你就会发现那里没有温暖和生机的迹象。
所以... 老了以后千万别住在这里。

scripts.text: Then why are you here?
scripts.translation: 那你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: I won't. Thanks for the advice.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢你的建议。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]
Well, I have some
precious memories of
this place. Once, there was
a man who lived here who
was just like a father to me.
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
嗯，我对这个地方有着珍贵的回忆。
曾经，这里住着一位老人，他对我来说就像父亲一样。

scripts.text:
[Uwe]

you don't want to hear

drop by, we'll talk about
something more fun, 'kay?
Buhbye for now, cutie~
scripts.translation:

那先拜拜了，亲爱的~

scripts.text:

Oh, that is such
a good decision,
sugar honey! Oh, you
cutie adventurers are
so precious, so lovable.
^333333*Tee hee hee~*^000000
scripts.translation:
[乌维]
噢，真是个好决定，甜心！
噢，你们这些可爱的冒险者真是太珍贵、太讨人喜欢了。
^333333*嘻嘻嘻~*^000000

scripts.translation:

烹饪始于火，也终于火。
要做出美味佳肴，
让味蕾得到满足，
其中自有其艺术~

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
What...?
Factory Repair
budget? No way!
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
什么...？
工厂修复预算？
绝不可能！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
Why waste money?
We haven't had any
problems so far! Look,
everything's fine! Why
are you exaggerating
such small details?
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
为什么要浪费钱？
我们到现在为止都没出过问题！
你看，一切都好着呢！
为什么要夸大这些
微不足道的小事？

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
The field overseer,
Zelmeto, just came by to
ask for a budget increase.
Well, I think he's lying!
Everything's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
现场监督泽尔梅托
刚才过来要求增加预算。
哼，我觉得他在撒谎！
一切都很完美！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
I'm the plant
superintendant of this
factory. Most of my employees
are diligent workers. I can't say that of everyone, but overall we're doing an excellent job. Ha ha ha~!
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
我是这家工厂的厂长。
我的员工大多都很勤勉。
虽然不能说每个人都这样，
但总体来说，我们干得相当出色。
哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
So long as this factory
is well maintained, we won't
have to worry about this city's
safety. The field overseer,
Zelmeto, is also very reliable.
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
只要这家工厂维护得当，
我们就不必担心这座城镇的安全。
现场监督泽尔梅托
也是非常可靠的。

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
I can trust Zelmeto
to look after things,
so there's no need for
me to go inside the factory.
Delegating work is great!
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
我可以信任泽尔梅托
来照看这里，
所以我不需要亲自进工厂。
把工作委派给别人，
感觉真不错！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
Our factory will
continue to develop
and everyone will be
proud of the progress
we're making. Yes, I can
assure you of that!
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
我们的工厂将继续发展，
每个人都会为我们取得的
进步感到自豪。
是的，我向你保证！

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
What's going on?!
Who's responsible?!
God, I can't believe
this is happening!
^333333*Cough Cough!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
怎么回事？！
谁该为此负责？！
天哪，我简直不敢相信
会发生这种事！
^333333*咳咳！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Liotzburg]
I need to get out of here!
You! D-do something and
fix this! I gotta hide and find
someplace safe!
scripts.translation:
[利奥茨堡]
我得赶紧离开这里！
你！快...快想办法
把它修好！
我得躲起来，找个安全的地方！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We've got a big problem
here! I appreciate that you've
been gathering the materials,
but the machines have been
broken for too long!
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我们遇到大麻烦了！
我很感激你一直在收集材料，
但是机器已经坏了太久了！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Right when I tried to
fix it, a huge shortout
occurred. Our town is
probably filled with
toxic fog right now!
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
就在我试图修复它的时候，
发生了巨大的短路。
我们的城镇现在
大概已经充满了有毒的雾气！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I'll try my best to fix
this, but we really should
have allocated some funds
to fix this machine earlier!
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我会尽力修复它的，
但我们真的应该早点
拨出资金来修复这台机器！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
The most important
thing is that you get
out of here and find
shelter! Right now!
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
现在最重要的是，
你赶紧离开这里，
找个地方避难！
马上！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We'll be putting good
use to the materials you
gave me. With your help,
our factory will operate
safely. At least, for just
a little while longer.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我们会好好利用
你给我的材料。
有了你的帮助，
我们的工厂就能安全运行。
至少，还能再撑一小会儿。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Ah, it's you again.
It's shameful letting
other people know about
our miserable situation...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
啊，又是你。
让别人知道我们
这种凄惨的处境...
真是丢人...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
There's nothing
worth seeing here,
so there really isn't
a point in you coming to
visit this place anymore.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
这里没什么值得看的，
所以你也没必要
再来这个地方了。

scripts.text: Give him materials.
scripts.translation: 给他材料

scripts.text: Huh.
scripts.translation: 哈。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
...Hm?
Aren't these the
materials we need
to make repairs in
the factory? How did
you find all of these?
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
...嗯？
这些不正是我们
维修工厂所需的材料吗？
你是怎么找到
这些东西的？

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I don't know how
I can possibly pay you
back for this great favor.
I appreciate that you've
stepped forward to help us.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我真不知道该如何
报答你这份大恩。
非常感谢你
挺身而出帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Oh...!
In my years of managing,
I've learned the ultimate
motivation techniques. Let
me enhance your motivation
to show you my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
哦...！
在多年的管理工作中，
我学会了终极的激励技巧。
让我来增强你的动力，
以表达我的谢意。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Now...
Just open your mind
and listen to my words
of encouragement
and inspiration...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
现在...
请敞开心扉，
聆听我为你带来的
鼓励和灵感...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^236B8EWhen the going
gets rough, you've
gotta get rougher!
You gotta climb that
mountain 'cause no one's
gonna climb it for you!^000000
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
^236B8E当事情变得艰难时，
你必须更加顽强！
你必须去攀登那座山，
因为没人会替你爬！^000000

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^236B8EDon't give it up!
Go for broke!
Losers are quitters
and quitters are losers!
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
^236B8E别放弃！
全力以赴！
失败者就是放弃者，
放弃者就是失败者！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^333333*Whew*^000000
I haven't given that much
inspriration in a while, but
your help was well worth it.
I'm going to start the repairs, but once again, I'd like to thank you.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
^333333*呼*^000000
我很久没给过别人
这么多灵感了，
但你的帮助非常值得。
我要开始维修了，
再次感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I'm really worried
about this factory's
future. What is our
superintendant thinking...?
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
我真的很担心
工厂的未来。
我们的主管在想什么...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We need
at least
20 ^FF0000Flexible Tubes^000000,
10 ^FF0000Rusty Screw^000000 and
10 ^FF0000Used Iron Plate^000000
to repair this factory.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我们需要至少
20个^FF0000软管^000000、
10个^FF0000生锈的螺丝^000000和
10个^FF0000老旧的铁板^000000
来维修这座工厂。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
But there's no way
we can get all of those
things. Our budget isn't
big enough to cover it...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
但我们根本不可能
弄到这些东西。
我们的预算不够支付......

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
My proposal was rejected
by our superintendant. But
maintainance and repairs
are crucial for peak operating
efficiency and worker safety!
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
^333333*叹气*^000000
我的提议被主管否决了。
但维护和维修对于
保持最佳运行效率和
工人安全至关重要！

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I'm frustrated and worried.
Maybe nothing will happen
for now, but we've got to
safeguard our future by
regularly maintaining
all of these machines.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我很沮丧也很担心。
也许现在不会发生什么，
但我们必须通过定期维护
所有机器来保障未来。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Even possible threats
to the safety of our workers
can't be ignored. Isn't there
something I can do? ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
即使是可能对工人安全
构成威胁的情况也不能忽视。
我能做些什么吗？^333333*叹气*^000000

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
If we can
just get
20 ^FF0000Flexible Tube^000000,
10 ^FF0000Rusty Screw^000000 and
10 ^FF0000Used Iron Plate^000000,
we could make those repairs.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
如果我们能弄到
20个^FF0000软管^000000、
10个^FF0000生锈的螺丝^000000和
10个^FF0000老旧的铁板^000000，
我们就能进行维修。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
But without funds, there's
no way we can purchase
those items. If something
happens, who's going to
be responsible?
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
但没有资金，我们根本
买不到这些东西。
如果出了事，谁该负责？

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I've got to report this
to our superintendant
as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我必须尽快向主管
汇报这件事。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
With any luck, he'll approve
a budget increase so that we
can get all of the materials
needed for the repairs.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
但愿他能批准增加预算，
这样我们就能买到
维修所需的全部材料了。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Well, I figured that both
conveyors would have
similar problems. We
can fix them at the
same time, but it'll
be a hassle.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我想这两条传送带
应该都有类似的问题。
我们可以同时修复它们，
不过会很麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thank you so much for
your help. Without you,
I'm pretty sure we wouldn't
know about these problems
until it was too late.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
非常感谢你的帮助。
如果没有你，
恐怕我们要等到
问题严重了才会发现。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Now, I've got to make sure
we have enough materials
to make the repairs so that
the machines will be safely
functioning again.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
现在，我得确保
我们有足够的材料
来进行维修，
让机器重新安全地运行。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
First, I better
hurry and request
an increase for the
Factory Repair budget
from our superintendant.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
首先，我得赶紧
向主管申请
增加工厂维修的预算。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
The machine which
you are supposed to
inspect right now
is a large conveyor.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
你现在需要检查的机器
是一条大型传送带。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Remember that we
also have a small sized
conveyor, so make sure
that you examine the
larger one, alright?
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
记住，我们还有一条
小型传送带，
所以请确保你检查的是
那条较大的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
This is
worse than
I imagined...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
这比我想象的
还要糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We've got to start
repairs as soon as we
can! Hopefully, we can
resolve this before any
serious problems happen...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我们必须尽快
开始维修！
希望能在发生严重问题
之前解决它...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Alright, the last
thing that you need to
inspect is a ^FF0000large converyor^000000.
It's similar to the one you
inspected before, but it's
bigger and more powerful.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
好了，你需要检查的
最后一台机器是
一条^FF0000大型传送带^000000。
它和你之前检查的那条
很像，但更大，动力也更强。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We have only one of these
machines and it's usually
moved around a lot since
a lot of people in the factory
use it. I really don't know
where it could be now.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
这种机器我们只有一台，
而且因为工厂里很多人
都在使用它，
它经常被移动。
我真的不知道它现在
在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Still, I'm sure that
it's inside the building,
so you should be able to
find it. I hope you can inspect
that conveyor for me soon.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
不过，我确信它
就在建筑物里面，
你应该能找到它。
希望你能尽快
帮我检查那条传送带。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
This time, you need
to inspect an outdoor
pipe that is located far
outside of the factory.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
这次，你需要检查的
是一根位于工厂
外面的室外管道。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Since there aren't any
other machines in that
area, that pipe shouldn't
be too hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
既然那个区域没有
其他机器，
那根管道应该
不难找到。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Huh?
I'm suprised to hear
that. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 There's just
too many things that need
fixing. This is terrible...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
咦？
听到这个我有点惊讶。
^333333*叹气*^000000 需要修理的东西
实在太多了。这太糟糕了...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Well, let me worry
about that for now. Please
focus on continuing to inspect
some of the other machines.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
好吧，这件事
先让我来担心吧。
请继续专注于
检查其他机器。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Now, there's a pipe inside
this factory that I want you
to look at. Many of our pipes
aren't in the best condition,
but this particular one might
be severely damaged.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
现在，工厂里有一根
管道我想让你看看。
我们的很多管道
状况都不太好，
但这根可能损坏得很严重。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Now, the pipe I want
you to inspect is located
near those large caultrons
of molten metal. You should
be able to find it pretty easily.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我要你检查的那根管道
位于那些大型熔炉附近。
你应该能很容易找到它。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thanks again
for your help,
adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
再次感谢你的帮助，
冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
The machine which
I want you to inspect
this time is a small
sized conveyor.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
这次我要你检查的机器
是一条小型传送带。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Be sure that you
inspect the small
one, since we also
have a large conveyor
in the factory as well.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
请务必检查小型的那台，
因为工厂里也有一台
大型传送带。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I see...
It's most likely that
there was a short
circuit and most
of the internal devices
were burnt out...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我明白了...
很可能是短路了，
大部分内部设备
都烧毁了...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thanks for checking
that out for me. Now,
the next machine I need
you to inspect is different
than the others I've had
you examine.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
谢谢你帮我检查。
接下来，我需要你检查的机器
与之前让你检查的那些
都不一样。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
It's a mechanical
hand that transports
small objects. We didn't
really give it a name, but
you should be able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
那是一只搬运小物件的
机械手。我们并没有
给它起名字，
但你应该能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Recently, it seems
that there have been
problems in operating
that machine. If something's
broken, we need to know
and fix it right away.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
最近，那台机器似乎
在运行上出现了问题。
如果有什么损坏，
我们需要立刻知道并修复。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thanks again
in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
再次提前
表示感谢。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I'd like you to inspect
the control panel. It's
fairly large and can be
found in the middle of the
factory. You shouldn't have
too much trouble finding it.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我想让你检查
控制面板。它相当大，
位于工厂的中央。
你应该不难找到它。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
What...?
This is worse
than I expected. But
it's good that we know
about these problems
as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
什么...？
这比我预想的还要糟糕。
但能尽早发现
这些问题是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Don't you worry,
we'll take care of
this. In the meantime,
I'd like you to inspect
the next machine for me.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
别担心，
我们会处理好的。
在此期间，
我想让你再检查
下一台机器。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
I want you to check
a ^FF0000control panel^000000. It's the
same kind as the one
you just inspected, but
bigger in size.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我想让你检查一个
^FF0000控制面板^000000。它和你刚才检查的
是同一类型，
但尺寸更大。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
It's located in the
middle of the factory,
so you should be able
to find it. It may be in bad
condition, even though it's
operating fine for now...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
它位于工厂的中央，
所以你应该能找到它。
虽然现在运行正常，
但它的状况可能很糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
We need to ensure that
it's stable, reliable and
doesn't pose a threat to
our workforce. Thanks
again, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我们需要确保它
稳定、可靠，
并且不会对我们的
员工构成威胁。
再次感谢，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
You need to inspect
an automatic pressure
governor. It looks fine,
but sometimes it makes
strange noises.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
你需要检查一个
自动压力调节器。它看起来
没问题，但有时
会发出奇怪的声音。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
It probably will
be a good idea to
check that machine
more carefully this
time, just in case.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
这次最好
仔细检查一下那台机器，
以防万一。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thank you
for helping us,
adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
谢谢你
帮助我们，
冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Huh, I see.
We must do something
about that as soon as
we can. Now, let me tell
you what to check next.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
嗯，我明白了。
我们必须尽快
处理这个问题。现在，
让我告诉你
接下来要检查什么。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
There are 3 automatic
pressure governors which
hammer the bent iron plates
from above to flatten them. It
seems that one of them may
have some kind of problem.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
有3个自动压力调节器
从上方锤击弯曲的铁板
使其变平。似乎其中
一个出了点问题。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Please inspect the ^FF0000automatic pressure governors^000000. Even if the
problem seems small, please
report it to me. I know it might seem fine now, but I want to prevent an accident if I can.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
请检查^FF0000自动压力调节器^000000。即使问题
看起来很小，也请
向我报告。我知道现在
可能看起来没事，
但我想尽量防止事故发生。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thank you
in advance,
adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
提前
表示感谢，
冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
If you would,
please inspect the
2nd control panel that
seems to have been
broken for a while...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
如果可以的话，
请检查那个
似乎已经损坏
了一段时间的
第2个控制面板...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Ah, you must be a visitor.
I'm Zelmeto Abellov, the
field overseer. Have you
been in this facility before?
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
啊，您一定是位访客吧。
我是泽尔梅托·阿贝洛夫，
这里的现场主管。
您以前来过这个设施吗？

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
This factory plays an
important role in our city
and generates a lot of income.
However, our employees suffer
from a poor work environment.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
这家工厂在我们的城市中
扮演着重要的角色，
并带来了大量的收入。
然而，我们的员工
却遭受着恶劣工作环境的折磨。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Our superintendant makes a lot
of money and seems content with
the current situation. However, the rest of the workforce doesn't enjoy all of the benefits he receives...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
我们的主管赚了很多钱，
似乎对现状很满意。
但是，其余的员工
却无法享受他所得到的所有福利...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Many people have already
quit and there are only a few
people who continue to work
here. So now we're understaffed
and I'm in quite a bind...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
很多人已经辞职了，
只剩下少数人
继续在这里工作。
所以现在人手不足，
我陷入了相当为难的境地...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
There are some urgent
tasks I need done, but
there's no way for me
to recruit new workers.
Ah, I'm sorry, I've spoken too
freely about my own problems...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
有一些紧急的任务
需要完成，但我没有办法
招募新的工人。
啊，抱歉，我
太随意地谈论自己的问题了...

scripts.text: You're understaffed?
scripts.translation: 人手不足？

scripts.text: No, it's okay.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Yes, we are!
I don't have enough
people to inspect the
factory machines and
determine what kinds
of problems we have.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
是的，我们人手不足！
我没有足够的人手
去检查工厂的机器，
并确定我们遇到了
什么样的问题。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
It's a time consuming
task I'd rather do on my
own. However, between that
and managing the workforce,
I don't have enough time...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
这是一项耗时的工作，
我宁愿自己去做。
然而，除了这个，
我还要管理员工，
我没有足够的时间...

scripts.text: I can help you.
scripts.translation: 我可以帮你。

scripts.text: Keep up the good job.
scripts.translation: 继续加油。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
You can help me?
I know something like
this is too much to ask,
but I'll accept any help
anyone offers me. I'm
that desperate.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
您能帮我吗？
我知道这要求
可能有点过分，
但我会接受任何人
提供的帮助。我
已经走投无路了。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Alright, I'll have you
inspect the machines
in the factory one by one.
It's imperative that we know
what needs to be repaired
and what's working fine.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
好的，我会让你
逐一检查工厂里的机器。
我们必须知道
哪些需要修理，
哪些运行正常。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
First, find the ^FF00002nd control
panel^000000 and determine its
status. I'm fairly certain that
it broke a long time ago, but
it wouldn't hurt to make sure.
You should find it easily.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
首先，找到^FF0000第2个控制面板^000000，
并确定它的状态。
我相当确定它
很久以前就坏了，
但确认一下也无妨。
你应该很容易找到它。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
When you finish your
inspection, report back
to me so I can tell you
which machine to check
next. Thanks again for
offering to help.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
当您完成检查后，
回来向我报告，
这样我就可以告诉您
接下来要检查哪台机器。
再次感谢您
愿意提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Well, it's a living.
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I can put up with
this, but I hope the higher
ups will consider improving
the work environment here...
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
嗯，这就是生活。
^333333*叹气*^000000我可以忍受
这些，但我希望高层
能考虑改善这里的工作环境...

scripts.text:
[Zelmeto]
Thank you for
your kindness.
And please don't
let anyone know about
anything I just told you.
scripts.translation:
[泽尔梅托]
感谢您的善意。
还有，请不要让任何人
知道我刚才告诉您的事情。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's the 2nd control panel
Zelmeto asked you to inspect.
It looks totally broken: screws
are missing, and the iron cover
has been bent open, revealing
a tangled mess of wires inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是泽尔梅托让您检查的第2个控制面板。
它看起来完全坏了：螺丝不见了，
铁盖被掰开了，露出了里面一团乱糟糟的电线。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAt first glance, this
pressure governor looks
perfectly fine. But after you
check it more carefully, you
find that it's making strange
grinding noises and a few of
the surface screws are loose.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF乍一看，这个压力调节器
看起来完全没问题。但经过仔细检查，
您发现它发出了奇怪的摩擦声，
而且表面的一些螺丝松动了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe main control panel
doesn't look like it has
any problems. But after
tapping on its surface,
you hear a disheartening
hollow sound. It looks like
it's missing some parts...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF主控制面板看起来
没有任何问题。但在敲击它的表面后，
您听到了令人沮丧的空洞声。

松动且生锈了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe inspection of this
pipe didn't take very long.

from long durations of 
being overloaded with
pressure. It's a wonder
it hasn't exploded yet.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF检查这根管道并没有花多少时间。
它因长期承受过大的压力而膨胀、磨损。
它竟然还没有爆炸，真是奇迹。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis conveyor seems
to have similar problems
as its smaller version. Its
movements are awkward,
erratic and weak, and almost
all of its screws are rusted.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这条传送带似乎和它的小型版本有同样的问题。
它的动作笨拙、不稳定且无力，
而且几乎所有的螺丝都生锈了。^000000
