RaaaaAAAARGHHH!!

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe old man seems
slightly irked at seeing
you. Unfortunately, his
screaming and rambling
is totally incoherent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF老人看到你似乎有些恼怒。
不幸的是，他的尖叫和胡言乱语完全语无伦次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
It ^FF0000IS^000000 you!
You're responsible!
You've taken everything
away from me!!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
是你^FF0000没错^000000！
都是你的错！
你夺走了我的一切！！

scripts.text: 'What are you talking about?'
scripts.translation: “你在说什么？”

scripts.text: Ignore Him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
How dare you...
How dare you treat 
after destroying all the
happiness in my life!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
你竟敢...
你竟敢在我毁掉我生活中所有的幸福之后，
还这样对我！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Damn you...
How can you have
the audacity to pretend
as if nothing happened?!
^333333*C-cough Cough...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
该死...
你怎么敢假装什么都没发生过？！
^333333*咳咳 咳咳...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
W...wait!
I said wait!
^333333*Cough!*^000000

[Buender Hikeman]
Are you so evil to
just shallowly forget
what you've done to our
lives? Did you already
forget what you did
here in Einbech?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
你竟然如此邪恶，
就这样轻飘飘地忘记
你给我们生活带来的灾难吗？
你已经忘了
你在这里，在艾音贝赫做过的事了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
It was such a long
time ago, but I'll never
forget. This town was
small, but full of folk
with warm hearts...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
虽然那是很久以前的事了，
但我永远不会忘记。
这个城镇很小，
但这里的人都有一颗温暖的心...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Me, Khartophe, Anuto,
Maskharundt... All of
us were friends hired
by that big businessman
to dig up ores in the mine.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我，卡托夫，阿努托，
马斯哈伦特...我们所有人
都是受雇于那个大商人，
在矿里挖掘矿石的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
And then there
was you! All of us
put together made the
greatest mining team!
That was, until, we
discovered ^FF0000it^000000.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
然后就是你来了！
我们所有人加在一起，
组成了最棒的采矿队伍！
直到...我们发现了^FF0000它^000000。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Yes...
The mysterious ore
that dazzled with a
magnificent light.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
是的...
那块闪烁着
壮丽光芒的神秘矿石。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
But we should have known
that the ^3131FFUngoliant^000000 would
be around that ore. We
should have realized
the danger...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
但我们本该知道，
^3131FF温古力安特^000000会在那块矿石附近。
我们本该意识到危险的...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
We reported our findings
to our employer, and then
the ore just disappeared. He
must have sent it somewhere,
it was none of our business.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我们把发现报告给了雇主，
然后矿石就消失了。
他一定是把它运走了，
那跟我们没关系。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Then life was back
to normal for a while.
But one day you yelled
to us that you had found
another special, mysterious
ore in the mines.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
之后生活恢复了一段时间的正常。
但有一天你冲我们大喊，
说你在矿里又发现了一块
特殊的、神秘的矿石。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
But when we came
over to check the hole
you dug up, you know
what we found...?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
但当我们过来查看
你挖的那个洞时，
你知道我们发现了什么吗？！

scripts.text: Ungoliant?
scripts.translation: 温古力安特？

scripts.text: A mysterious ore, right?
scripts.translation: 一块神秘的矿石，对吧？

scripts.text: Nothing...?
scripts.translation: 什么都没有...？

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Don't you remember
what happened? What
you did to us at that time?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
你不记得发生了什么吗？
你当时对我们做了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Don't you remember
what happened? What
you did to us at that time?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
你不记得发生了什么吗？
你当时对我们做了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Yes...
Nothing.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
是的...
什么都没有。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
There was nothing
inside the hole!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
那个洞里什么都没有！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Then you pointed to
the wall behind us and
screamed that Ungoliant
was coming! In our panic
we started to dig our way out!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
然后你指着身后的墙壁，
尖叫着说温古力安特来了！
我们在惊慌中开始挖掘逃生！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
I remember that the expression on your face seemed so strange. I had thought you looked sad, but now I'm sure you were consumed by greed! We trusted you and you betrayed us! ^FFFFFFspace^000000
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我记得你当时的表情看起来很奇怪。我以为你是悲伤，但现在我确信你是被贪婪吞噬了！我们信任你，你却背叛了我们！ ^FFFFFF<黑暗搜集者>暮光^000000

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
When we finally smashed
down that last wall, everything
starting to fall around us. We
were the only two to survive
that tunnel collapse.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
当我们终于砸穿最后一堵墙时，
周围的一切开始崩塌。
只有我们两个人
在那次隧道坍塌中幸存了下来。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Then I learned...
You planned it all along.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
然后我明白了...
你从一开始就计划好了这一切。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Bastard!
I'm sick of
your lies!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
混蛋！
我受够了
你的谎言！

scripts.text: I'm not who you think!
scripts.translation: 我不是你想的那个人！

scripts.text: How did you survive the accident?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么在那场事故中幸存下来的？

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Ha...!
Do you think
I'd so easily
forget the face
of the person who
shattered my life?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
哈...！
你以为我会轻易忘记
那个粉碎我人生的人的脸吗？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
When I came to,
I was lying on my
stomach in the ruins
of that dark tunnel.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
当我醒来时，
我正趴在
那条黑暗隧道的废墟中。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
And I found...
You know what I found.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
然后我发现了...
你知道我发现了什么。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
The corpses of my friends!
Khartophe, Anuto, Maskharundt!
Great men and my best friends.
But where were you?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
我朋友们的尸体！
卡托夫、阿努托、马斯哈伦特！
他们是优秀的人，也是我最好的朋友。
可你在哪里？！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Your body was nowhere
to be found. I searched
the tunnel and finally
climbed outside where
I was found unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
到处都找不到你的身影。我搜遍了隧道，
最后爬了出去，
醒来时发现自己昏迷不醒。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
I was so stupid.
It was because of
that ore! You killed our
friends and destroyed
my life for that thing!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我太愚蠢了。
都是那块矿石的错！你为了那个东西
杀死了我们的朋友，
毁了我的人生！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
And now...
You come out of
hiding and show up.
What do you want of
me? What more can
you possibly take away?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
而现在...
你从藏身处出来，
现身了。
你想从我这里得到什么？
你还想夺走什么？！

scripts.text: I'm not who you think I am!
scripts.translation: 我不是你想的那个人！

scripts.text: I'd like to apologize.
scripts.translation: 我想向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Quit lying!
You've stirred up
my hatred by showing
up again! I've never
forgotten that day!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
别撒谎了！
你再次出现，
激起了我的仇恨！我从未
忘记那一天！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Ha ha...
Apologize?
The harm is
already done...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
哈哈...
道歉？
伤害已经造成了...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
It's too late
for you now. For
the sake of my friends,
I'll have my vengeance!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
现在对你来说
太迟了。为了我的朋友们，
我要复仇！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Prepare to die!
^3131FFShinokas^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
准备受死吧！
^3131FF希诺卡斯^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
...!
^333333*Cough! Cough!*^000000
Noooo! N-not now...
^333333*Cough! Cough!*^000000

[{0}]
...
I better
get away
from him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...
我最好
赶紧离开他！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ran away from Hikeman
as he collapsed on the ground.
It wouldn't be a good idea to
provoke the old man anymore,
intentionally or not.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF海克曼倒在地上时，你逃走了。
无论是有意还是无意，
都不应该再激怒这位老人了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt'd be best
to avoid aggravating
the old man for now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF目前最好避免
再激怒这位老人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHikeman is dozing
off in his chair. Judging
from the look of discomfort
on his face, he seems to be
having a nightmare.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF海克曼在椅子上打瞌睡。
从他脸上痛苦的表情来看，
他似乎正在做噩梦。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...

[Buender Hikeman]
Huh...?
.........!!
Hahahahaha!
Come back for
your beating,
eh, Shinokas?!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
嗯...？
.........！！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
来受死吧，
希诺卡斯？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look...!
I'm not Shinokas,
okay? How can you
forget what he looks
like or how old he is?
I'm way younger!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看...！
我不是希诺卡斯，
好吗？你怎么会忘记
他的长相和年纪？
我年轻多了！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
What...?
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
什...么？

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
................

[Buender Hikeman]
Uhhhh......
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
唔......

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Huh.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
嗯。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And...
I'm a cute girl!
Shinokas is male
and kind of...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且...
我是个可爱的女孩！
希诺卡斯是男性，
而且有点...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
What...?
IMPOSSIBLE!
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
什...么？
不可能！

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
...
......

[Buender Hikeman]
It seems...
I've made a
huge mistake.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
看来...
我犯了一个
大错。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Ever since the accident, people have said that I haven't been the same. Maybe they're right.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
自从那次事故以来，人们都说我不一样了。也许他们是对的。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
I keep making the same
mistakes, so maybe they're
right about me getting senile.
Did you come just to clear
up this misunderstanding?
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我不断犯同样的错误，所以也许他们说我老糊涂了是对的。
你是来澄清这个误会的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
Actually...
Tell Hikeman about Shinokas's death.
scripts.translation: 告诉海克曼希诺卡斯已经死了

scripts.text: Don't notify Hikeman.
scripts.translation: 不告诉海克曼

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shinokas died
a while ago in
Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希诺卡斯
不久前
在艾音布罗克去世了。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Wh-what...?
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
什...什么...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shinokas was killed by
some men. He thinks they
may have been the ones
who hired you guys. In the
end, he was betrayed too...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希诺卡斯被
几个男人杀死了。他认为
他们可能就是
雇佣你们的人。
最后，他也被背叛了...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
I...
I see...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
我...
我明白了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shinokas may have
gotten some money,
but he spent the rest
of his life in hiding,
being hunted down.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希诺卡斯或许得到了一些钱，
但他余生都在隐匿中度过，
被人追杀。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Nothing's left.
I've got nothing
to look foward to.
I was living only to
avenge my friends...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
什么都没有了。
我没有什么可以期待的了。
我活着只是为了
为我的朋友复仇...

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Please...
Just go back to
wherever you came
from. Leave me alone...
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
请...
回到你来的地方吧。
别管我了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333Did Hikeman really want
revenge on Shinokas or did
he want to hear him out since
they used to be close friends?^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333海克曼是真的想向希诺卡斯复仇，
还是因为他们是旧友，
想听听他的说法？^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333If I mention that
what they found was
the Ymir Heart Piece,
Hikeman might end up
getting hunted down, so
I better not say anything.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333如果我提到他们找到的是
尤米尔之心碎片，
海克曼可能会遭到追杀，
所以我最好什么都别说。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333Why are those men
so obsessed with that
Ymir Heart Piece? Is it
really worth this kind of
cruelty? Whoever they are,
their intentions can't be good.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333那些人为什么对那块
伊米尔之心碎片如此执着？
它真的值得用这种残忍的手段去夺取吗？
不管他们是谁，他们的目的绝不会是善意的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah...
That' right.
I wanted to clear up
this misunderstanding
so you could calm down,
even if it's just a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊...
没错。
我想解开这个误会，
让你能冷静下来，
哪怕只是一点点也好。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Well, you don't have
to worry so much about
my stress. I find that the
winds that pass through
this town to be very relaxing.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
嗯，你不必太担心
我的压力。我发现
穿过这座城镇的风
非常令人放松。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Each time the wind
blows by, my vision blurs,
my memories haze and all
of my hatred just drifts away.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
每当风吹过，
我的视线就会模糊，
记忆变得朦胧，
所有的仇恨也随之消散。

scripts.text:
[Buender Hikeman]
Without the wind, I'd only
have my hatred towards ^FF0000him^000000.
Maybe it's my only reason for
living and maybe I'm lonely,
but it's too late to feel
sorry for myself now.
scripts.translation:
[本德·海克曼]
如果没有风，
我就只剩下对^FF0000他^000000的仇恨了。
也许这是我活着的唯一理由，
也许我很孤独，
但现在自怜已经太迟了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFHikeman is dozing
off in his chair. Judging
from the look of discomfort
on his face, he seems to be
having a nightmare.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF海克曼在椅子上打瞌睡。
从他脸上痛苦的表情来看，
他似乎正在做噩梦。

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
...!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
...！

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Awwwk~
It's killing me!
Arrrgh! Awwwrgh!
W-when will my son
come back from
the factory...?!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
啊呜~
疼死我了！
啊！啊呜！
我...我儿子什么时候
能从工厂回来...？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel really awkward
just staring at this old
man violently rolling
around in his bed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看着这位老人在床上
剧烈地翻滚，
只是盯着他看，
我感到非常尴尬。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
...!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
...！

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Awwwk~
It's killing me!
Arrrgh! Awwwrgh!
W-when will my son
come back from
the factory...?!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
啊呜~
疼死我了！
啊！啊呜！
我...我儿子什么时候
能从工厂回来...？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shi...
Shinokas?

[Sick Old Man]
Huh...?
Noooo! M-my name is
Shinotarous. Y-you've
got the wrong person!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
嗯...？
不不不！我...我叫
希诺太郎。你...你找错人了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333This has to be the
Shinokas that Hikeman
was talking about in Einbech.
Hmmm, but how can I get
him to admit it?^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333这一定是海克曼在艾音贝赫
提到的那个希诺卡斯。
嗯，但我怎么让他承认呢？^000000

scripts.text: Have you ever heard of ^3131FFHikeman^000000 before?
scripts.translation: 你以前听说过^3131FF海克曼^000000吗？

scripts.text: Weren't you living in ^3131FFEinbech^000000?
scripts.translation: 你以前住在^3131FF艾音贝赫^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Einbech...?
No! I've never
lived there before!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
艾音贝赫...？
不！我从来没
在那里住过！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't seem
like this old man
is telling the truth...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这位老人似乎没有说实话...^000000

scripts.text: Remember the mine tunnel collapse?
scripts.translation: 还记得矿洞坍塌的事吗？

scripts.text: Didn't you used to be a miner?
scripts.translation: 你以前是矿工吗？

scripts.text: Have you lived in Einbroch all your life?
scripts.translation: 你一直在艾音布罗克生活吗？

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Noooo!
I don't know
what the hell
you're talking
about!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
不不不！
我完全不知道
你在说什么！

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Nooo...!
W-why would you
even ask me that
kind of question?!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
不...！
你...你为什么要
问这种问题？！

scripts.text:
[Sick Old Man]
Y-yes!
Born and raised
raised here in
Einbe--Einbroch!
scripts.translation:
[生病的老人]
是...是的！
我出生并长大
在艾音...艾音布罗克！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't seem
like this old man
is telling the truth...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这位老人似乎没有说实话...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you sure
that you don't
know anything
about ^3131FFHikeman^000000?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你确定你
对^3131FF海克曼^000000
一无所知吗？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
No...!
I've never met
Buender Hikeman
in my entire li--
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
不...！
我这辈子都
没见过本德·海克曼...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...
.......

[{0}]
I was right.
You're Shinokas!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我猜对了。
你就是希诺卡斯！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Curses!
I've blown
my cover!
W-wait! How much
do you know?!
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
该死！
我的身份暴露了！
等...等等！你知道多少？！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Did ^3131FFthey^000000 send you?
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I think that this
is it. I'll never be
able to solve the
secret before I die.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
是^3131FF他们^000000派你来的吗？
^333333*叹气*^000000 我想这就是结局了。
我死前也永远无法解开这个秘密。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Okay.
Get on with it.
I'm ready now...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
好吧。
继续说吧。
我现在准备好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tell me everything
you know related to
that incident where
the mine tunnel
collapsed around
you and Hikeman.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
告诉我你知道的一切，
关于那次矿洞坍塌事故，
你和海克曼当时都在场。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...?
Errr....
You're not
here to kill me?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
...？
呃...
你不是来杀我的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No...!
I'm here to find
out the truth!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...！
我是来查明真相的！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
That means...
I still have some time.
This must be destiny!
Alright, I'll tell you what
happened. But it's a
long story...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
那意味着...
我还有点时间。
这一定是命运！
好吧，我会告诉你发生了什么。不过故事很长...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
How much do you know
about the accident? No,
wait. Don't answer that.
I don't want to hear it.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
你对那次事故了解多少？
不，等等。别回答。
我不想听。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I admit it. Yes.
I stabbed my friends
in the back. It was an
unforgivable sin that will
haunt me until the day I die.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
我承认。是的。
我背叛了我的朋友。这是不可饶恕的罪孽，
将伴随我直到死去的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I sold out my friends for
money. I destroyed that
tunnel and killed them. But
I suppose I was tricked as well. ^3131FFThey^000000 never intended to keep their end of our agreement.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
我为了钱出卖了朋友。我炸毁了隧道，杀了他们。但我想，我自己也是被骗了。^3131FF他们^000000从一开始就没打算遵守我们的约定。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
After I destroyed the tunnel,
they targeted me and I ended
spending the rest of my life being pursued and running from place to place. What the hell was that ^3131FFore^000000 and why was it so important?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
在我炸毁隧道之后，他们开始追杀我，我不得不度过余生，四处逃亡。那^3131FF矿石^000000到底是什么？为什么它那么重要？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I need to know more about
that ore if it's worth killing for. That's why I've risked sneaking into Einbroch. Supposedly, an ore similar to the one we found has
been transported here recently.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
如果那种矿石值得为此杀人，我就必须了解更多。这就是我冒险潜入艾音布罗克的原因。据说最近有一种与我们发现的那块相似的矿石被运到了这里。

scripts.text: Did you find it?
scripts.translation: 你找到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
No, not yet.
I've been searching
for that ore every night.
During the day, this kind
blacksmith has managed
to hide me from those men.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
还没有。
我每天晚上都在寻找那种矿石。
白天，这位铁匠帮我藏起来，躲避那些人的追捕。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
But I won't be safe
for very long. Look, I'm
no saint, but before I die,
I wanna do this one last
thing and see what's so
great about this ore...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
但我不会安全太久。听着，我虽然不是圣人，但在死之前，我想做最后一件事，看看这种矿石到底有什么特别之处...

scripts.text: Wait, who's trying to get you?
scripts.translation: 等等，是谁在追杀你？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Who's trying to kill me?
The people who hired me and
my friends to dig up that ore in the first place. We thought they were ordinary businessmen,
but... They're dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
谁想杀我？
就是当初雇佣我和朋友去挖那块矿石的人。我们以为他们是普通的商人，但...他们很危险。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
So I told you everything
and now you know that my
days might be numbered.
Please do an old man a favor
and search Einbroch for that
strange, mysterious ore.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
所以我什么都告诉你了，现在你也知道我的日子可能不多了。
请帮一个老人个忙，去艾音布罗克找找那种神秘莫测的矿石。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Now, the first thing I learned
in this town is that the richest family is the Kapellthaines. Only the rich and powerful can possibly be involved in something so big.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
首先，我在这个城镇了解到，最富有的家族是卡佩尔泰因家。只有富人和权贵才可能卷入这么大的事情。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Would you search
Kappellthaine Manor
for that ore? It's on the way
to the Airport and it shouldn't be hard to miss. They're the richest people in Einbroch, after all.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
你能去卡佩尔泰因庄园找找那种矿石吗？它在去机场的路上，应该很容易找到。毕竟，他们是艾音布罗克最富有的人。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I'm too old and weak to leave
this house, and there's the chance that those men will find me. If you can sympathize with my situation, please find out if the Kapellthaine family has any unique ores...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
我年纪大了，身体虚弱，无法离开这栋房子，而且那些随时可能找到我。如果你能体谅我的处境，请查一下卡佩尔泰因家族是否藏有什么特殊的矿石...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Please...
Find out if the Kapellthaines
are keeping some kind of unique
ore. Their manor is on the road
that leads to the Airport.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
拜托了...
查一下卡佩尔泰因家族是否藏有某种特殊的矿石。他们的庄园就在通往机场的路上。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
So, did you find
anything from the
Kapellthaines?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
那么，你在卡佩尔泰因家找到什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, Mr. Kapellthaine
is kind of violent, but
I didn't find anything
really suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，卡佩尔泰因先生有点暴力，但我没发现什么特别可疑的东西。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Huh...
I must have
been wrong, then...
Where else could it be?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
哈...
看来是我搞错了...
那它还能在哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Oh, right! The huge
factory in Einbroch!
What could be more
suspicious? There's a ton
of workers, but no one really
knows what they do there...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
对了！艾音布罗克那座巨大的工厂！
还有什么比那更可疑的吗？那里有很多工人，但没人知道他们在那里做什么...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
If they're so secretive,
it's possible that they're
keeping the ore over there.
Please go and search the
Factory for that ore as
soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
如果他们这么神秘，有可能就是把矿石藏在那里了。
请尽快去工厂找找那种矿石。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
So...?
Did you learn
anything new
in the Factory?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
那么...？
你在工厂里
有什么新发现吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
There's a lot of
suspicious business
in the factory, but I don't
think any of it is related
to that ore you mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
工厂里有很多可疑的勾当，但我觉得没有一件和你提到的那种矿石有关。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Damn it...
Then where did
they hide it? Where
do you think that
ore might be?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
该死...
那他们到底把它藏在哪里了？
你觉得那种矿石可能在哪里？

scripts.text: Airport
scripts.translation: 机场

scripts.text: Factory
scripts.translation: 工厂

scripts.text: Train Station
scripts.translation: 火车站

scripts.text: Airship Repairshop
scripts.translation: 飞空艇维修店

scripts.text: Laboratory
scripts.translation: 实验室

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
No...
The Airport is always
crowded with people.
It'd be a bad idea to hide
something so important
in that kind of place.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
不...
机场总是人山人海。
把那么重要的东西藏在
那种地方，绝对是个坏主意。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Didn't you just
check the factory?
You couldn't find
any clues to the
ore over there...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
你刚才不是
刚去工厂查过了吗？
你在那边
没有找到任何
关于矿石的线索...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Hmm...
People are always going
in and out of the Train Station. It's not the best place to hide something as important as the ore.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
嗯...
火车站总是进进出出的人很多。
把矿石这么重要的东西藏在那里，
并不是最好的选择。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
The Airship? Hm, it does
fly through some mysterious
power... But I already checked
the Airship Repairshop myself.
I haven't found any trace of
the ore over there.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
飞空艇？嗯，它确实
靠某种神秘的力量飞行...
但我已经亲自去
飞空艇维修店查过了。
我没有在那里
找到任何矿石的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...!
Yes. Yes...!
That could be it!
Why didn't I think
about the Laboratory?
It makes so much sense!
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
...！
是的。是的...！
可能就是那里！
我为什么没想到
实验室呢？
这太合理了！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I have a good feeling
about this. Please sneak
into that Laboratory and
see if you can find the ore!
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
我对这件事
很有预感。请潜入
那个实验室，
看看能不能找到矿石！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Remember...
Not just anybody
can enter that kind
of place. But I'm sure
you'll figure something out.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
记住...
不是谁都能
进入那种地方的。但我相信
你一定能想出办法的。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I'm really in no position
to ask and I'm not trying
to give you a hard time on
purpose, but would you please
check for any traces of the ore
in the Factory once again?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
我其实
没有立场要求你，
我也不是故意
要为难你，但你能不能
再去工厂查一次
矿石的痕迹？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shinokas,
I found something!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希诺卡斯，
我发现了什么！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
You...
Came... back...
Even... if... it's
already... Too late.
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000

^3355FFYou help Shinokas
sit up, but find that
your hands have been
stained with his blood.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你扶希诺卡斯
坐起来，却发现
自己的手
沾满了他的血。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Blood...?!
Shinokas!
Who did this to you?
W-we need to call for help!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
血...？！
希诺卡斯！
是谁对你做的？
我...我们需要叫人来帮忙！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
No...
It's already
too late for me.
I should have died
a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
不...
对我来说
已经太晚了。
我其实
早就该死了...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
^333333*Cough*^000000
I only regret that
I've never been able
to apologize to my
friends... ^333333*Cough!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
^333333*咳嗽*^000000
我唯一的遗憾是
我从来没有
向我的朋友们
道过歉... ^333333*咳嗽！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
But did you
find out? D-did
you find out what's
so special about
that ore? W-what
is it... Really?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
但是，你
查清楚了吗？你...你
查清楚那种矿石
有什么特别之处了吗？它...它
到底是什么？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
Y-Ymir...?
The h-heart of Ymir?
The power to control
the world... We really
did find something
great, didn't we?
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
伊...伊米尔...？
伊...伊米尔的心脏？
控制世界的力量...我们
真的找到了
不得了的东西，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
I remember...
The first time
we saw it. We...
We were so excited.
So amazed and proud...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
我记得...
第一次看到它的时候。
我们...
我们太兴奋了。
太惊讶，太自豪了...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
But digging up...
Something so great...
Was only possible
with-- ^333333*Cough*^000000 --
M-my buddies...
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
但是挖掘...
如此伟大的东西...
只有靠-- ^333333*咳嗽*^000000 --
我...我的伙伴们...

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
^333333*Cough*^000000
It's getting...
Darker... I...
Don't have to
run anymore.
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
^333333*咳嗽*^000000
周围变得...
越来越暗了... 我...
不用再逃了。

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
W-wait...!
What did...
I can't underst--
^333333*Cough cough!*^000000

[{0}]
No...!
Tell me who
did this to you!
Where are they?
Speak to me, please!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...!
告诉我，是谁
对你做了这种事！
他们在哪里？
请跟我对话！

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
W-wha...?
I told you.
Th-they we--
scripts.translation:
[希诺卡斯]
什...什么...？
我告诉过你。
他...他们曾--

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...
......

[{0}]
No!
Shinokas!
Why, God?
Why...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！
希诺卡斯！
为什么，神啊？
为什么...

scripts.text:
^3355FFShinokas's
body has grown
cold to the touch.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF希诺卡斯
的身体已经冰冷了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Shinokas]
...
......

[Maid]
Did you ask me
if I saw some kind
of ore around here?
That's strange...
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
你问我
有没有看到
附近的矿石？
真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Well, I've been with
this family for a long
time. Let me assure you
that there's no secrets
from me in this household!
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
嗯，我在这个
家族工作很久了。
请放心，
这个家里没有任何
对我保密的秘密！

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I'm sorry, but I don't
think we have any ores,
special or otherwise, here
in the manor. What exactly
do you need them for?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
抱歉，我想我们
这里没有矿石，
无论是特别的还是普通的。
你具体需要它们做什么？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
There's no end
to all these plates
I have to clean...!
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
这些碟仙恶灵
没完没了地
需要我清理...!

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
^333333*Grumble grumble*^000000

[Scientist]
Huh...?
How did you
get in here?
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
嗯...？
你是怎么
进来的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Ah....
I'm the new...
Guard. Nice
to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！啊....
我是新来的...
卫兵。很高兴
见到你。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Oh. Yeah.
Nice-meet-you.
..............
^333333*Grumble grumble*^000000
What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text: Catch you later.
scripts.translation: 回头见。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
What's wrong...?!
Oh, don't get me started!
I'm stuck here doing all the
work while the Lab Department Head goes out every freakin' day!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
怎么了...？!
哦，别提了！
我留在这里做所有的工作，
而实验室主任每天都出去鬼混！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
While I'm slaving
away here, he's in
that Airship, busy
flirting with that
woman. God...!
I'm like, so teed off!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
我在这儿拼命干活，
他却在那艘飞空艇上，
忙着和那个女人调情。天哪...!
我真是气炸了！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Right.
Yeah.
Later, man.
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好的。
嗯。
回头见，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Man alive!
Would it kill the
Department Head
to come in here and do
some work for a change?!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
天哪！
难道主任就不能
偶尔来这儿
干点活儿吗？！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
I mean, come on!
I shouldn't have to
carry his workload!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
我是说，拜托了！
我不应该
替他承担工作量！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something
attached to a huge
machine with many cords
and folds of barbed wire.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有一样东西
附着在一台巨大的机器上，
上面有许多电线
和带刺的铁丝网。^000000

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Soldier]
This area
is off limits.
Please leave
immediately.
scripts.translation:
[实验室士兵]
此区域
禁止入内。
请立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Soldier]
Yuck...!
There's this
nasty dusty taste
right inside my mouth
that I can't get rid of!
scripts.translation:
[实验室士兵]
恶心...！
我嘴里
有一股难闻的灰尘味，
怎么都去不掉！

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Soldier]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I want to go home.
Get some mouthwash.
You know. Something.
scripts.translation:
[实验室士兵]
^333333*叹气*^000000
我想回家。
去买点漱口水。
你知道的，随便什么。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Okay okay...
Daddy's gonna
win some Apples
this time for sure!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
好好好...
爸爸这次
肯定能赢到苹果！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Let's do it!
^3131FFYmir's Heart^000000 is
on my side! GO!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
来吧！
^3131FF伊米尔之心^000000
站在我这边！冲啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
What did he just say?
It seemed important!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
他刚才说什么？
听起来很重要！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[Kaci]
I have a total of ^FF000011^000000
and you have total ^FF00005^000000.
You lose this game. I'm
sorry, but I hope we play
again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
我的总分是 ^FF000011^000000，
你的总分是 ^FF00005^000000。
你输掉了这局。
很抱歉，希望下次
还能再玩。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Waaaaaahhhhhhhhh!
Apples! My apples!
Apples, I need more...!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
哇啊啊啊啊啊！
苹果！我的苹果！
苹果，我需要更多...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want
some of mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要不要
分我一些？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
What...?
I can't do anything
with so few Apples!
I'm a high roller and
this is a high stakes game!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
什...？
只有这么点苹果
我什么都做不了！
我是个大赌徒，
这是场高风险的游戏！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want
some of mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要不要
分我一些？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Wha--? Yes...
Hell yes! Gimme
some of your Apples!
Yeeeeeeeeeeehaw!
I'm back, baby!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
什...？是的...
当然！快把你的苹果
给我一些！
耶嘿嘿嘿嘿！
我回来了，宝贝！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Now, to win!
Daddy needs love...
Time to go from
crappy to classy!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
现在，去赢吧！
爸爸需要爱...
是时候从
糟糕变得优雅了！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[Kaci]
I got a total of ^FF00008^000000,
and you have total ^FF000011^000000.
Congratulations, you won!
Let me give you your winnings
and we'll play again some time~
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
我的总分是 ^FF00008^000000，
你的总分是 ^FF000011^000000。
恭喜你，你赢了！
让我把奖金给你，
我们改天再玩~

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oooh...
I got a total of ^FF000010^000000,
and you have a total of ^FF00007^000000.
I'm sorry, but you lose
again. Better luck next time...
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
噢...
我的总分是 ^FF000010^000000，
你的总分是 ^FF00007^000000。
很抱歉，你又输了。
下次好运...

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Waaaaahhhhhhhhhh!
Waaaaaaahhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
哇啊啊啊啊啊！
哇啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Mwahhahahahaha!
Whahahahahahahaha!
That's why they call me
the ''Resurrection Kid!''
I always come back!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
这就是为什么他们叫我
“复活小孩”！
我总是能回来！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Oh yes, right!
You...! You lent
me those lucky
Apples. ^333333*Hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
啊对对对！
你...！你借给我的
那些幸运苹果。
^333333*打嗝*^000000

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
I'm Kurshenburg!
Thanks to you, I'm
on a winning streak!
Hahaha! Th-thank you~
^333333*Hic-hic-hiccup!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
我是库尔森伯格！
多亏了你，我
现在连胜中！
哈哈哈！谢...谢谢你~
^333333*嗝-嗝-嗝*^000000

scripts.text: So what was that about Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation: 那关于尤弥尔之心是怎么回事？

scripts.text: Hehe, you're welcome.
scripts.translation: 呵呵，不客气。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
What...?
Ymir's Heart?
How do you know
about that? ^333333*Hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
什...么？
尤弥尔之心？
你怎么会知道
那个东西？
^333333*打嗝*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Y-you...!
You were just yelling,
''Ymir's Heart is on my
side,'' while you were
gambling with those Apples!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你刚才
在拿那些苹果赌博的时候，
一直在大喊
“尤弥尔之心在我这边”！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
What...?!
No way~
Err...? Did I...?
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
什...么？！
不会吧~
呃...？难道我...？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Heh heh...
I'm not really
supposed to be talking
about this. As head of
the Laboratory, I'm sworn
to secrecy about Ymir's Heart.
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
嘿嘿...
其实我不太应该
谈论这个。作为实验室的负责人，
我对尤弥尔之心负有保密义务。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
But what do I care?!
All they want are the
results of my research!
They don't appreciate
my work at all! My title
is completely worthless!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
但我管他们干什么！
他们只想要我的研究成果！
他们根本不尊重我的工作！
我的头衔完全一文不值！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
You don't know how long I've
been imprisoned in the lab and
that the work conditions just get worse and worse. Screw them! I'll keep getting paid as long as I show them some progress in our project!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
你不知道我被关在实验室里多久了，
而且工作条件越来越差。
去他们的吧！只要我向他们展示项目有进展，他们就会一直付我薪水！

scripts.text: Project?
scripts.translation: 项目？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Yeah, we're researching
Ymir's Heart. It was found
a long time ago in ^3131FFEinbech^000000
and it's in our lab now.
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
是的，我们正在研究
尤弥尔之心。它很久以前在
^3131FF艾音贝赫^000000被发现的，
现在就在我们的实验室里。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Everyone knows it's supposed
to hold some legendary power,
but even I was surprised to see
what it was capable of. It's both terrible and miraculous, scary
and wondrous...
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
大家都知道它应该蕴含着某种传奇的力量，
但连我都惊讶于它的能力。
它既可怕又神奇，既恐怖又美妙...

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
So...
I figure...
It may even
have the power to
win me Dice games!
Bwahaha--^333333*Hiccup!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
所以...
我想...
它甚至可能拥有
让我在骰子游戏中获胜的力量！
哇哈哈--^333333*打嗝！*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(That thing I saw
hooked up to all those
wires in the Laboratory
must have been a piece
of ^3131FFYmir's Heart^333333. I better
tell Shinokas about this.)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333(我在实验室里看到的那个
连接着所有电线的那个东西，
一定是^3131FF尤弥尔之心^333333的一部分。
我最好告诉希诺卡斯这件事。) ^000000

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Hahahaha!
You're great!
And I feel great!
Everything's great!
Bwahahahaahahah!
^333333*Hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
哈哈哈！
你太棒了！
我感觉太棒了！
一切都太棒了！
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
^333333*打嗝*^000000

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Hahahaha!
You're great!
I feel great!
Everything's great!
Bwahahahaahahah!
^333333*Hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
哈哈哈！
你太棒了！
我感觉太棒了！
一切都太棒了！
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
^333333*打嗝*^000000

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Okay okay...
Daddy's gonna
win some Apples
this time for sure!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
好好好...
爸爸这次
肯定能赢到苹果！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Let's do it!
^3131FFYmir's Heart^000000 is
on my side! GO!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
来吧！
^3131FF伊米尔之心^000000
站在我这边！冲啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
What did he just say?
It seemed important!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
他刚才说什么？
听起来很重要！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[Kaci]
I have a total of ^FF00003^000000
and you have total ^FF00002^000000.
You lose this game. I'm
sorry, but I hope we play
again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
我的总分是 ^FF00003^000000，
你的总分是 ^FF00002^000000。
这一局你输了。
很抱歉，希望我们改天再玩。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Waaaaaahhhhhhhhh!
Apples! My apples!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
哇啊啊啊啊啊！
苹果！我的苹果！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe open window rattles
as you enter the room and
are welcomed by a sudden
chill. A trail of red footprints
lies near your feet.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你进入房间时，
敞开的窗户发出嘎吱声，
一阵突如其来的寒意袭来。
你的脚边有一串红色的脚印。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA grey sheet lies
rumpled on the bed,
but you can see dark red
stains in between the folds.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一张灰色的床单皱巴巴地堆在床上，
但在褶皱之间，可以看到暗红色的污渍。^000000

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Behind the pub,
you'll see this old man
who's always mumbling
something to himself.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
在酒馆后面，
你会看到一个总是自言自语的老人。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Sometimes he seems really
angry, but other times he looks
awfully depressed. He must have
lived through some really horrible experience. I can't help but feel really sorry for the old guy.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
有时他看起来很愤怒，
但其他时候又显得非常沮丧。
他一定经历过一些非常可怕的事情。
我不禁为这位老人感到难过。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
He says and does
a lot of strange things.
It's sad to see someone
that old act that way, but
it makes me wonder what
could have happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
他说的和做的
都很奇怪。
看到这么大年纪的人这样
令人难过，
但我不禁想知道
他到底经历了什么。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
^8B0000*Beep Boop*^000000
Restricted Access Area.
Please identify yourself
through the system.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
^8B0000*哔哔*^000000
限制进入区域。
请通过系统验证您的身份。

scripts.text: Identify.
scripts.translation: 识别

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 资讯

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Security System]
Enter the following
password in 60 seconds.
Failure to do so will result
in lockout. Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
请在60秒内输入以下密码。
若未成功输入，系统将锁定。请稍候。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
^3CBCBC{0}^000000

[Security System]
^3CBCBCBy the power of p-po-poi-po-poi-poin-poing
GOD-POING. I NEVER LOSE!^000000
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
^3CBCBC以波-波波-波波伊-波波伊恩-波因之力
神·波因！我永不言败！^000000

scripts.text: [Security System]
scripts.translation: [安保系统]

scripts.text:
[Security System]
^FF1493{0}^000000

[Security System]
^FF1493{0}^000000

[Security System]
^FF1493{0}^000000

[Security System]
^FF1493{0}^000000

[Security System]
^FF1493{0}^000000

[Security System]
^800080{0}^000000

[Security System]
^800080{0}^000000

[Security System]
Time over.

for you to enter the
password. Initiating
lockout. Access denied.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
时间到。
您输入密码耗时 ^ff0000{0} 秒^000000。
正在启动锁定。访问被拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
It took ^ff0000{0} seconds^000000
for you to enter the
password. Initiating
override. Access granted.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
您输入密码耗时 ^ff0000{0} 秒^000000。
正在启动覆盖。访问已授权。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
You have failed
the identification
check. Access denied.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
身份验证失败。访问被拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
You must use the
security system in order
to gain access into the
Einbroch Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
您必须使用安保系统才能进入艾音布罗克实验室。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
You will be given
a password that you
must input correctly
within 60 seconds.
Otherwise, you will
fail the security check.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
您将获得一个密码，必须在60秒内正确输入。
否则，您将无法通过安全验证。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
If you take longer
than 3 minutes to
enter the password,
the security system
will initiate lockout.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
如果您输入密码的时间超过3分钟，安保系统将启动锁定。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
You have canceled
the ID security check.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
您已取消身份安全验证。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe door is locked.
You cannot enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF门被锁住了。
您无法进入。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Hello adventurer.
Our city must just be
another place where
you'll stay no longer
than a few days.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你好，冒险者。
我们的城市，
想必只是你旅途中
停留几天的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
You must have so much
freedom. I envy you. I can't
do what I want to do. I don't
even have the courage to tell
my family what I really want,
much less change things here...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你一定很自由吧。我好羡慕你。
我无法随心所欲地生活，
甚至没有勇气告诉家人
我真正的想法，
更别提改变这里的现状了...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
How is it like?
Going wherever you
please, following your
heart's true desire?
What I would give to
be able to do that...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
那种感觉怎么样？
随心所欲地旅行，
追随内心真正的渴望？
我多么希望能做到那样啊...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Thank you so much!
I'll try my best to convince
my parents to accept our
relationship. It'll be hard,
but it's a good first step~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
非常感谢你！
我会尽力说服父母
接受我们的关系。
虽然很难，
但这已经是好的开始了~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I hope that we can all
work together to improve
relations between Einbech
and Einbroch. The hatred
between our towns must end...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我希望我们大家能共同努力，
改善艾音贝赫和艾音布罗克
两座城市之间的关系。
两城之间的仇恨必须结束...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I really appreciate
what you've done for
all of us. I'll be praying
for your safety, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我非常感激你为我们所做的一切。
我会为你祈祷，
保佑你平安，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I just heard from my mother
that she's planning to have
tea with Klitzer! I'm sure that
I have you to thank for this~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我刚听母亲说，
她打算和克利策一起喝茶！
这肯定多亏了你~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I never dreamed that
something as wonderful
as this could happen.
I'm so happy, I could cry...
I'll always be grateful
for what you've done.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我从未想过
会有这么美好的事情发生。
我太开心了，简直要哭了...
我会永远感激你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I feel like such a fool,
thinking it was all hopeless.
I'll be doing my best to have
my parents accept Klitzer and
someday we'll be married~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我真觉得自己像个傻瓜，
以为一切都无望了。
我会尽力让父母接受克利策，
总有一天我们会结婚的~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
There isn't much that I can
give you, but I can show you
one of my family's secrets.
It's an invigorating massage
technique that makes you a lot
healthier in only ten seconds.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我没什么能给你的，
但我可以向你展示
我们家的一个秘密。
那是一种令人精神振奋的按摩技巧，
只需十秒钟就能让你感觉更健康。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Well, please take
off your equipment
and stand still while
I give the massage. It
might hurt a bit at first...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
那么，请脱下装备，
站好别动，
让我给你按摩。
刚开始可能会有点疼...

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Rub Rub Rub*
*Knead Knead Knead*
*Crrack C-c-c--c-crack*
*Crack Crack Crrrrrrack*
*Rub Crrraaaaaaaaaack*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*揉揉揉*
*捏捏捏*
*咔咔咔咔*
*咔咔咔咔咔*
*揉咔咔咔咔咔*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ooooooooh...
I feel sooo
sore and yet
soooooo good.
Wait. Now I just
feel goooood~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢噢噢噢...
感觉好酸，
但是好舒服。
等等。我现在
只觉得好舒服~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
So how was it?
I hope it was refreshing.
Please understand that
it's the best thing I can
give you to show my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
感觉怎么样？
希望让你感到神清气爽。
请理解，
这是我为了表达感激
能给你的最好的东西了。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Once again,
thank you so
much, {0}.
I'll always pray for
your safety on your
your adventures~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
再次感谢，{0}。
我会一直为你祈祷，
保佑你在冒险中平安~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
You've spoken
with Klitzer? How
is he? What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你和克利策
谈过了吗？
他怎么样？
他说了什么？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Oh...?
He asked you to
deliver this flower
to me? How sweet~
Thank you very much,
kind adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
噢...？
他让你把这朵花
带给我？好贴心~
非常感谢你，
善良的冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Ah, I'm so rude!
I've been calling you
''adventurer'' this whole
time you've been helping
me! Would you please
tell me your name?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
啊，我太失礼了！
你一直在帮我，
我却一直叫你“冒险者”！
能告诉我你的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Ah, {0}!
Such a lovely name~
I promise that I won't ever
forget it. Oh, and if you pass by Einbech, would you thank Klitzer for the flower for me please?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
啊，{0}！
真是个好听的名字~
我保证永远不会忘记它。
哦，如果你路过艾音贝赫，
请帮我谢谢克利策送的花好吗？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
A-and... And...
Please tell him that
I really miss him a lot.
^333333*Sob Sob...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
还...还有...
请告诉他，
我非常非常想念他。
^333333*抽泣抽泣...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I'm sorry...
I didn't catch that.
Would you please tell
me your name again?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
抱歉...
我没听清。
能请你再告诉我
一次你的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Oh my god...
Are you alright?
I just found out that
you ran into my father!
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
天哪...
你没事吧？
我刚刚得知
你遇到了我父亲！

scripts.text:
[Calla]
By all means,
try to avoid my dad!
He doesn't trust anyone
who's not considered part
of the upper class, even
adventurers like you!
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
无论如何，
请尽量避开我爸爸！
他不信任任何
不被视为上流社会的人，
即使是像你这样的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Would you please
take this Violin and
try to make it to Klitzer
this time? Thank you
for your help~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
请帮我带上这把小提琴，
这次务必把它交给克利策。
谢谢你的帮助~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Oh, please send my
regards to Klitzer for me.
I wish I could comfort
him in person, but this
is the best I can do for now.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
哦，请帮我向克利策
问好。
我希望能亲自安慰他，
但现在我只能做到这些了。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
You're the adventurer
from before, aren't you?
Sadly, there isn't much
to do around here. This
place is basically like
a prison to me...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你是之前的那位冒险者，
对吧？
遗憾的是，这里没什么
可做的。对我来说，
这个地方基本上就像监狱...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Oh, you've met Klitzer?
Isn't he so kind, and such
a perfect gentleman?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
哦，你见过克利策？
他是不是很善良，
而且是个完美的绅士？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I really wish I could
see him, but it's almost
impossible. My parents think
he's not good enough for me,
but they're wrong! What am
I going to do? Oh, Klitzer...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我真的很想见他，
但这几乎是不可能的。
我父母觉得他配不上我，
但他们错了！我该怎么办？
哦，克利策...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Well, maybe I can't see
him, but would you give
my violin to Klitzer for me?
I used to play this for him
all the time...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
嗯，也许我见不到他，
但你能帮我把这把小提琴
交给克利策吗？
我以前经常为他演奏...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I'm sorry to trouble you,
but please understand
that I want to comfort my
Klitzer in any way that
I possibly can. Thank
you so much, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
抱歉给你添麻烦了，
但请理解，我想尽一切可能
去安慰我的克利策。
非常感谢你，冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Hello adventurer.
Our city must just be
another place where
you'll stay no longer
than a few days.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你好，冒险者。
我们的城市，
想必只是你旅途中
停留几天的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
You must have so much
freedom. I envy you. I can't
do what I want to do. I don't
even have the courage to tell
my family what I really want,
much less change things here...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你一定很自由吧。我好羡慕你。
我无法随心所欲地生活，
甚至没有勇气告诉家人
我真正的想法，
更别提改变这里的现状了...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
How is it like?
Going wherever you
please, following your
heart's true desire?
What I would give to
be able to do that...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
那种感觉怎么样？
随心所欲地旅行，
追随内心真正的渴望？
我多么希望能做到那样啊...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Look out, world!
I'm gonna become
worthy of Calla's love!
Someday, maybe even her
parents will approve me!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
看好了，世界！
我要变得配得上卡拉的爱！
总有一天，也许连她的
父母也会认可我！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Waaaah!
What should I wear?!
I can't for the life of me
figure this out! Something,
um, formal? I've never worn
anything like that before!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
哇啊啊！
我该穿什么？！
我怎么也想不出来！
穿点...嗯，正式点的？
我以前从来没穿过那种衣服！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Wait, {0}.
What's that you've got
there? I've seen something
like that before. It's called
a Tuxedo, right? Something
like that would be perfect!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
等等，{0}。
你手里拿的是什么？
我以前见过类似的东西。
那是燕尾服，对吧？
穿那种应该很完美！

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 给他

scripts.text: Ignore Him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I can have this?
Oh, thank you so much!
Finally, I have something
nice enough to wear to meet
Calla's mom! What a relief!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我可以拥有这个？
哦，太感谢了！
终于，我有足够体面的衣服
去见卡拉的妈妈了！
真是松了一口气！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
You've been helping me all
this time and I haven't properly expressed my gratitude. I'm sorry
if I've been too absorbed in my own problems. I may be poor, but I need to repay you somehow...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你一直帮着我，
我却没好好表达感谢。
抱歉，我一直沉浸在自己的
烦恼中。虽然我可能很穷，
但我必须想办法报答你...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Wait...
Why don't you have this
ore? I don't know how
valuable it is, but I know
that it's pretty rare. It may
even be useful to you later~
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
等等...
你拿着这块矿石吧。
我不知道它有多值钱，
但我知道它相当稀有。
也许以后对你有用~

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
{0},
you've really opened
my eyes. From now on,
I'll do my best to earn the
approval of Calla's parents and
become worthy of Calla's love.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
{0}，
你真是让我大开眼界。
从现在开始，
我会尽力获得卡拉父母的认可，
并变得配得上卡拉的爱。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
But how can I get
a Tuxedo? Ooh, I hope
it doesn't cost too much
zeny or I won't be able to
get one of those soon...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
但我怎么才能得到
一件燕尾服呢？哦，希望
它不会太贵，否则我
可能买不起...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Noooooo!
I've got to find
the perfect thing
to wear or Calla's
mother might ^FF0000hate^000000 me!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
不不不！
我必须找到完美的
衣服，否则卡拉的妈妈
可能会^FF0000讨厌^000000我！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
What am I gonna do?!
Okay, nothing too flashy
or revealing. Can't let her
think I'm wild, immature or
unpredictable. Should I
wear suspenders or a belt?!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我该怎么办啊？！
好吧，不能太花哨，也不能太暴露。
不能让她觉得我轻浮、幼稚或者不可预测。
我该穿背带裤还是系皮带？！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Noooooo!
I've got to find
the perfect thing
to wear or Calla's
mother might ^FF0000hate^000000 me!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
不不不！
我必须找到完美的
衣服，否则卡拉的妈妈
可能会^FF0000讨厌^000000我！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Think, Klitzer, think!
Okay, no fun colors.
I don't want her to
think I'm not serious
about Calla. Stripes
might be bad too...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
想想看，克利策，想想看！
好吧，不要鲜艳的颜色。
我不想让她觉得我对卡拉不够认真。
条纹可能也不太好...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Eh...?
What did you just say?
You did something for
the Kapellthaines?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
咦...？
你刚才说什么？
你为卡佩尔泰因家做过什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
What...?
Did you just say
that Calla's mother
wants me to have tea
with her? Holy moley...!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
什么...？
你刚才说卡拉的母亲
想让我去和她喝茶？
天哪...！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Okay, okay.
I-I I'll need something
nice to wear, right? Oh.
Wow. This is so sudden!
W-what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
好的，好的。
我...我需要穿得好看一点，对吧？
哦。
哇。这也太突然了！
我...我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
This monkey suit
that I've got on just
won't do! Arrrgh! But I've
already outgrown all of my
nice clothes already. Boy,
am I in a pickle...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我身上这件猴子装
肯定不行！
啊！但我已经长高，
以前的漂亮衣服都穿不下了。
真是让人头疼...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
*Sigh...*
What can I do to
get Calla's parents
to accept me as her
boyfriend? I can't
think of anything...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
*叹气...*
我该怎么做，
才能让卡拉的父母
接受我做她的男朋友呢？
我想不出任何办法...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
You've given her
the flower? That's
great! Thank you,
thank you so mu--
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你已经把花给她了？
太好了！谢谢你，
真的非常感谢你——

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
...Oh!
Gosh! I was thinking so
much about myself that
I forgot to ask you for your
name! I'm sorry for being
so knuckle-headed...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
...哦！
天哪！我一直只顾着想自己的事，
竟然忘了问你的名字！
抱歉，我真是个大笨蛋...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
So...
What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
那么...
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
{0}...
That's very nice. Thank you,
I'm really grateful for your help. Although I can't see Calla in
person, I can at least send
my regards if you help me.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
{0}...
这个名字真好听。谢谢你，
真的很感激你的帮助。虽然我无法亲自见到卡拉，
但如果你愿意帮我，
我至少可以向你转达我的问候。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I feel so much
better now. Oh!
When you have the
time, why don't you talk
to my mother? She always
likes meeting my friends.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我现在感觉好多了。
哦！
如果你有空的话，
能不能和我的母亲聊聊？
她总是喜欢见我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Hm...?
Oh, don't be
so nervous~
But would you please
tell me your name again?
I couldn't hear you...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
嗯...？
哦，别那么紧张~
不过你能再告诉我一次你的名字吗？
我刚才没听清...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Have you left to
see Calla for me yet?
I'm sorry if I sound
pretty demanding...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你还没去见卡拉吗？
抱歉，我听起来是不是有点太急切了...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Anyway, please
remember to bring
Calla ^FF00001 Flower^000000 for me.
It doesn't need to be
fancy, an ordinary one
should be just fine.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
总之，请记得帮我带
^FF00001朵花^000000给卡拉。
不需要太华丽，
普通的花就很好了。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
What brings you here?
Aren't you tired of hearing
me moan and whine about
lost love? ^333333*Siiiiigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你怎么来了？
难道你不听我抱怨失恋
听腻了吗？^333333*唉...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Hey, this violin...
Calla used to play
such beautiful music
on this for me. Did
she give this to you?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
嘿，这把小提琴...
卡拉以前经常用它
为我演奏美妙的音乐。
是她给你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I see. Calla must have
known that I'm all broken up
right now. She's too good to
to me. How can she consider
my feelings before thinking
about herself?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
原来如此。卡拉一定知道
我现在很伤心。
她对我太好了。
她总是把我的感受放在
她自己之前。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I know I'm being
shameless, but I have
a favor to ask. Adventurer,
would you please send
Calla a present for me?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我知道这样有点厚脸皮，
但我有个请求。冒险者，
你能帮我给卡拉送份礼物吗？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
All you need to do is
just give her ^FF00001 Flower^000000.
I don't have the zeny and
I don't think I'm welcome
at Kapellthaine Manor.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你只需要给她
^FF00001朵花^000000就行。
我没有足够的Zeny，
而且我觉得我也不太受欢迎
去卡佩尔泰因庄园。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Here, in return, I'll
give you this health
massage. It's not a
big deal, but when I'm
done, your mind and body
will be refreshed. Here goes!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
作为回报，
我要给你做个健康按摩。
虽然不算什么大事，
但做完之后，
你的身心都会焕然一新。
开始咯！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Knead Knead*
*Rub Rub Rub Rub*
*Press Press Press*
*C-c-c-c-c-c-crack!*
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*揉啊揉*
*搓啊搓搓搓*
*按啊按按按*
*咔...咔...咔...咔...咔...咔!*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh--
Hell yeah!
That's the stuff!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦——
太爽了！
就是这个感觉！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Would you please bring
1 Flower to Calla for me?
I'm sorry for troubling you...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
拜托你帮我送
1朵花给卡拉好吗？
真是不好意思麻烦你了...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I really appreciate your
sympathy, but I'm merely
a coward and a fool.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
^333333*叹气*^000000
我很感激你的同情，
但我只是个胆小鬼和傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Yeah...
I'm a coward for doing
nothing about my feelings
and an idiot for falling in love with such a high class girl in
the first place... Oh, Calla...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
是啊...
我对自己的感情无动于衷，
真是胆小鬼；
爱上这么高贵的女孩，
更是个白痴... 啊，卡拉...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
That faintly sweet
and pleasant scent...
It's just like the fragrance
they use in Calla's house.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
那淡淡而愉悦的香气...
就像卡拉家里
使用的那种香味。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Ah, so you visited
Calla in Einbroch?
I miss her sooo much!
Is she doing alright?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
啊，你去艾音布罗克
看望卡拉了吗？
我好想她啊！
她最近还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Calla's so beautiful.
And she's so lovely.
Every time I close my
eyes, I can still see
her lovely smile.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
卡拉那么美丽。
她那么可爱。
每次我闭上眼睛，
依然能看到
她那迷人的微笑。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I'm sorry if I sound
silly, but I can't help
it. I know I'm acting like
a complete idiot. But I'd
give anything to see her...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
如果我听起来很傻，
请见谅，但我控制不住。
我知道自己像个彻头彻尾的白痴。
但我愿意付出一切去见她...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Just...
Just don't listen
to anything I say.
I'm just a poor fool
in love with the wrong
person. That has to be it...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
只是...
别听我说的任何话。
我只是个爱上了
错误的人的可怜傻瓜。
一定是这样...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Is there something
that you really want
in life, but it's just
beyond your grasp?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
生活中有没有
你非常渴望，
却遥不可及的东西？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I wish I were more
like you adventurers.
People like you never
seem to give up, no matter
what the obstacles may be.
But I'm so helpless...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我真希望能像你们冒险者一样。
像你们这样的人，
无论遇到什么障碍，
似乎从不放弃。
但我却如此无助...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I can't even see
the one person that
I love. We've just so
different that it's not
even possible anymore...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我甚至见不到
我爱的那个人。
我们太不同了，
这已经不可能了...

scripts.text:
[Megass]
You again?!
What do you
want from me?!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
又是你？！
你想从我这里得到什么？！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
Guards...!
Sweep the driveway with
this guy's face and keep
punching the stomach
until there's nothing
left to throw up!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
卫兵...！
用这家伙的脸扫车道，
一直打他的肚子，
直到他吐不出东西为止！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
That's...
That's my
daughter's Violin.
I gave that to her
for her sweet sixteen...
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
那是...
那是给我女儿的
小提琴。
那是为了她
十六岁生日送的...

scripts.text:
[Megass]
It's bad enough to
intrude into my house,
but to steal from my Calla?!
You've crossed the line, punk!
Guards! Get over here!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
闯入我家已经够糟糕了，
竟然还偷我卡拉的东西？！
你越界了，朽魔！
卫兵！过来！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
Men, I want you to
knock the wind out
of this fool and anything
else that might be inside!
Make sure that if this punk
wakes up, it won't be today!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
伙计们，我要你们
把这个傻瓜打晕，
还有他肚子里的任何东西！
确保这个朽魔醒来时，
绝对不是今天！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
How dare you...
A vagabond like
you setting foot
into my home!?
Unthinkable!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
你竟敢...
像你这样的流浪汉
踏进我的家！？
简直不可思议！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
Leave immediately
before I report you
to the authorities
for trespassing!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
立刻离开！
否则我就以非法闯入的罪名
将你上报给当局！

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I understand that my
home is extravagantly
splendid and to approach
any Kappelthaine is an
honor to most commoners.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
我明白，
我家富丽堂皇，
对大多数平民来说，
能接近任何一位卡佩尔坦家族的人
都是一种荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
However, Klitzer
has no reason to feel so
intimidated. Tell the poor
boy that he's earned the
honor of speaking with me.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
不过，克利策
没有理由感到如此胆怯。
告诉那个可怜的孩子，
他已赢得了与我交谈的荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ho ho ho ho~
Welcome adventurer,
I so enjoy our little chats.
Hors d'oeuvre?
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
呵呵呵呵~
欢迎，冒险者，
我很享受我们的小小闲聊。
来点开胃菜吗？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh! You can't enjoy
any food in that state!
Your hands are atrociously
grimy! May I ask why?
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哦！
你那样可没法享用食物！
你的手脏得令人发指！
我可以问问原因吗？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ah~
In my excitement,
I nearly forgot that
I asked you to bring
Coals to me again!
My apologies~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
啊~
我一兴奋，
差点忘了
又让你给我带煤来了！
抱歉~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
You've brought so much Coal
to me, I'm convinced that you're much more diligent than those
languid peasants in Einbech.
I appreciate that you've labored so much to win my favor.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
你带给我这么多煤，
我确信你比艾音贝赫那些
懒散的农民勤快得多。
我很感激你如此辛苦地
为我效劳。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Hm, what was that?
Someone else provided
these Coals and you were
only delivering them? Then
who actually gathered these?
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
嗯，刚才说什么？
这些煤是别人提供的，
你只是负责运送？
那么，究竟是谁收集了这些煤？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ah, Klitzer?
I must say, that's
a very humble name.
Yet it's so familiar...
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
啊，克利策？
不得不说，
这是一个非常谦逊的名字。
但听起来很耳熟...

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ah, I recall there
was a hooligan that
has been pestering my
daughter named Klitzer.
Perhaps they are one
and the same. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
啊，我想起来了，
有个叫克利策的恶棍，
一直在骚扰我的女儿。
也许他们就是同一个人。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I remember that he was
rather shabby looking and
lacked any semblance of
etiquette whatsoever. Clearly,
he is a fool and a coward, but now I see that he is sincere.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
我记得他
看起来相当邋遢，
而且完全不懂礼仪。显然，
他是个傻瓜和懦夫，但现在我看到他是真诚的。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
It might not be possible
to let him go out with my
daughter straight away, but
I will invite him for a spot of
tea. And if Calla likes him,
well, he must be special.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
也许不能让他立刻
和我女儿约会，
但我会邀请他来喝杯茶。
如果卡拉喜欢他，
那他一定很特别。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
For a humble peasant,
this must be like a dream
come true! And to have tea
with Klitzer. Oh, what would
the girls say? Ah, but I did
marry that oafish Megass~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
对于一个卑微的农民来说，
这一定是梦想成真！
而且能和克利策一起喝茶。
哦，女孩们会怎么说呢？啊，但我确实
嫁给了那个粗鲁的梅加斯~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Anyway, when you next
meet Klitzer, please tell
him to pay me a visit soon.
Oh, and remind him to dress
appropriately for this special
occasion. Ho ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
总之，下次见到克利策时，
请告诉他尽快来拜访我。
哦，还要提醒他
为这个特殊场合穿得得体一些。呵呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I beg your pardon?
{0}? Oh my...
I believe I may have
misheard you. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
请原谅？
{0}？天哪...
我想我可能听错了。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ho ho ho ho~
Welcome adventurer,
I so enjoy our little chats.
Hors d'oeuvre?
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
呵呵呵呵~
欢迎，冒险者，
我很享受我们的小小闲聊。
来点开胃菜吗？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ah...
It seems you've
forgotten your ^FF0000Coals^000000.
A silly mistake, but one
I'm willing to overlook.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
啊...
看来你忘了带^FF0000煤^000000。
是个愚蠢的错误，
但我愿意原谅。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Why hello~
Your visits have
recently been quite
delightful, fair adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
你好~
你最近的拜访
非常愉快，
勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Continue to show
your appreciation
and dedication to me
and you'll soon be known
to be my most favored
commoner. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
继续向我展示
你的感激和奉献，
你很快就会成为
我最受宠爱的平民。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I'm sure you've noticed
the strained relationship
between Einbroch and Einbech
by now. It's a shame, really.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
我相信你
已经注意到
艾音布罗克和艾音贝赫之间
紧张的关系了。
这真是令人遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
As Einbroch grew wealthier
and Einbech became more
destitude, the affluent began
despising the impoverished.
I suppose it follows that the poor started to resent the rich.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
随着艾音布罗克变得富裕，
艾音贝赫变得更加贫困，
富裕者开始蔑视贫困者。
我想，穷人开始怨恨富人
也是顺理成章的。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
It might be said that
both towns have been
trying to take advantage
of each other, but it's
clear that Einbroch has
always had the upper hand.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
或许可以说，
两个城镇都在试图
占对方的便宜，
但很明显，
艾音布罗克
一直占据着上风。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
In fact, because of
this rift between our
cities, our families are
taught not to associate
with the people of Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
事实上，由于
我们两个城市之间的
裂痕，我们的家族
被教导不要与
艾音贝赫的人交往。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Now, I believe that most
people who live in Einbech
are peons, but that does not
mean I will not give them a
chance to prove their worth.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
现在，我相信
大多数住在艾音贝赫的人
都是平民，
但这并不意味着
我不会给他们一个
证明自身价值的机会。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Why should I deprive
the lowly of my gracious
presense if they prove
themselves meritable?
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
如果他们能证明
自己值得，
我为什么要剥夺
卑微者
享受我恩赐的荣幸呢？
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, that was scrumptious!
If you wish to pay me another
visit, don't forget to bring some Coal with you. Tah tah~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
啊，真美味！
如果你还想再来拜访，
别忘了带上煤哦。塔塔~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Why hello~
Your visits have
recently been quite
delightful, fair adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
你好~
你最近的拜访
非常愉快，
勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, my apologies!
I suppose you're just
here for sight seeing,
or perhaps you're running
some sort of adventurer's
errand. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哦，抱歉！
我想你只是
来观光，
或者是在执行
某种冒险者的任务。
我猜对了吗？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I know you well enough
to know that you wouldn't
be so rude as to stop by
and chat without bringing
any ^FF0000Coal^000000. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
我很了解你，
知道你不会
这么无礼，
不带任何^FF0000煤^000000
就停下来闲聊。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
^333333*Titter~*^000000
Why, if it isn't my
intrepid adventurer.
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
^333333*窃笑~*^000000
哎呀，这不是
我那勇敢的冒险者吗。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
My word!
Why are you carrying
all of that dirty Coal
with you? You poor,
impoverished thing.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
天哪！
你为什么
带着那么多脏兮兮的煤？
你真是个
贫穷可怜的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh! Dear me,
I've nearly forgotten~
How divinely silly of me!
Once again, I graciously
accept your small gift on
behalf of the Kappellthaines.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哦！天哪，
我差点忘了~
真是神圣的愚蠢！
再一次，我宽宏大量地
代表卡佩尔坦家族
接受了你的小礼物。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Let me share a little
bit of history concerning
our lovely Einbroch. At one
time, there was only Einbech,
the mining village. You can
imagine how long ago that was.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
让我分享一点
关于我们可爱的艾音布罗克的历史。
曾经，只有
艾音贝赫，
一个采矿村庄。
你可以想象
那是多久以前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
However, the minerals
and ores mined in Einbech
need to be processed and
refined in factories that were
all built in a nearby industrial complex which became Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
然而，在艾音贝赫开采的
矿物和矿石
需要在工厂中
进行加工和精炼，
这些工厂都建在
附近的工业区，
后来成为了艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Now every citizen in
Einbroch is wealthy and
it's well known that there
is a higher standard of
living here than in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
现在，艾音布罗克的
每一位市民都很富裕，
众所周知，
这里的
生活水平
比艾音贝赫高。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Goodness, I believe
it's time for a spot of tea~
The next time you wish to have
an audience with me, it would
behoove you to bring another
gift of Coal. Toodles~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
天哪，我想
该喝点茶了~
下次你想
与我见面时，
最好再带一份
煤作为礼物。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
^333333*Titter~*^000000
Why, if it isn't my
intrepid adventurer.
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
^333333*窃笑~*^000000
哎呀，这不是
我那勇敢的冒险者吗。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
My apologies, but you
must first prove to me
that you are worthy of
conversation. Why don't
you deliver more of those
^FF0000Coals^000000, mmm?
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
抱歉，但你
必须先向我证明
你有资格
与我交谈。
为什么不
再送一些
^FF0000煤^000000呢，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
After all, I have no other
means of knowing whether
or not you appreciate the time
I sacrifice by socializing with
someone of your status.
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
毕竟，我没有
其他方法
知道你是否
感激我
牺牲时间
与像你这样地位的人
社交。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
My, you've already
brought the Coal?
How charmingly
prompt you are~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哎呀，你
已经带来煤了？
你真是
太守时了~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
On behalf of the
Kappellthaine family,
I shall ignore your lowly
status and graciously
accept your small gift.
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
代表
卡佩尔坦家族，
我将无视你
卑微的地位，
宽宏大量地
接受你的小礼物。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Do you hail from
Einbech, adventurer?
Ah, the Rune-Midgarts
kingdom! I've visited your
country. It's quite quaint
and Jawaii is very lovely.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
你来自
艾音贝赫吗，冒险者？
啊，卢恩·米德加兹
王国！我去过
你的国家。
它相当古朴，
爪哇也很美丽。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Well, I shall try to
find some use for these.
I'm afraid the gift I've asked
from you isn't very practical.
How is Coal usually used?
Ah, I have a novel idea!
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
好吧，我会
设法利用这些的。
恐怕我向你索要的
礼物并不实用。
煤通常
是怎么使用的？
啊，我有一个
新奇的想法！

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Wouldn't it be
intoxicatingly wild if
Megass were to hold one
of those social functions that
the lower classes are so fond
of? A 'barbeque,' yes?
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
要是梅加斯能举办
一场那些下等人
特别喜欢的
社交活动，
那该多刺激啊？
没错，就是“烧烤”。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
In any case, if you
bring me more of that
Coal, you would be even
more favored by me and
you'll become a recipient
of my good graces. Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
总之，如果你
再给我带些
煤来，
我会更加
青睐于你，
让你成为
我恩宠的
受益者。呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
A wandering adventurer...?
How ravishingly delightful!
You must have risked life and
limb to sneak past my husband
to enjoy the captivating sights
of my home. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
流浪的
冒险者...？
真是令人
陶醉的
愉悦！
你一定
冒着
生命危险，
偷偷溜过
我丈夫，
只为欣赏
我家
迷人的
景色。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Since you're a very
unique guest, I shall
give you a unique honor
and deign to converse
with you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
既然你
是位
非常
独特的
客人，
我将
赐予你
独特的
荣耀，
并屈尊
与你
交谈，
冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Einbech exists to provide
my family with coal and
materials from their mines.
It's a natural law: workers
must be led by a chosen few.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
艾音贝赫
存在的
意义，
就是
为
我的
家族
提供
煤矿
和
材料。
这是
自然
法则：
工人
必须
由
少数
被选中
的人
来
领导。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
It's delightfully
ludicrous to see those
workers aspire to reach
our heights of social
prestige. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
看到
那些
工人
渴望
达到
我们
的
社会
地位，
真是
令人
发笑的
荒谬。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, I haven't spoken to
someone from a lower
class in ages! It feels
so forbiddenly exciting!
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哦，我
已经
很久
没有
和
下等人
说话
了！
感觉
真是
禁忌
又
刺激！

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Well adventurer, that's 
the end of our informal
chat. I'll even grant you
full permission to boast
of the fact that you've
spoken to Lady Satra.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
好了，冒险者，
我们的
非正式
闲聊
到此
结束。
我甚至
授予你
完全的
许可，
让你
可以
吹嘘
自己
曾
与
萨特拉
女士
交谈
过。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
If you do wish for
me to share words with
you once more, prove to
me that you're worthier
than the other peons of
my graceful presense.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
如果你
确实
希望
我
再次
与你
分享
言语，
那就
向我
证明
你
比
我
优雅
存在
下的
其他
杂役
更
有价值。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, I have a marvelous
idea! Why don't you bring
me ^990000Coals^000000? It's not impossible
for someone like yourself, but
this kind of task will require
some effort on your part.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哦，我
有个
绝妙
的
主意！
你
为什么
不
给我
带
^990000煤^000000
呢？
对
你
这样
的
人
来说
并
不
不可能，
但
这种
任务
将
需要
你
付出
一些
努力。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Tah tah,
adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哒哒，
冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
A wandering adventurer...?
How ravishingly delightful!
You must have risked life and
limb to sneak past my husband
to enjoy the captivating sights
of my home. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
流浪的
冒险者...？
真是令人
陶醉的
愉悦！
你一定
冒着
生命危险，
偷偷溜过
我丈夫，
只为欣赏
我家
迷人的
景色。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Since you're a very
unique guest, I shall
give you a unique honor
and deign to converse
with you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
既然你
是位
非常
独特的
客人，
我将
赐予你
独特的
荣耀，
并屈尊
与你
交谈，
冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Einbech exists to provide
my family with coal and
materials from their mines.
It's a natural law: workers
must be led by a chosen few.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
艾音贝赫
存在的
意义，
就是
为
我的
家族
提供
煤矿
和
材料。
这是
自然
法则：
工人
必须
由
少数
被选中
的人
来
领导。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
It's delightfully
ludicrous to see those
workers aspire to reach
our heights of social
prestige. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
看到
那些
工人
渴望
达到
我们
的
社会
地位，
真是
令人
发笑的
荒谬。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, I haven't spoken to
someone from a lower
class in ages! It feels
so forbiddenly exciting!
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哦，我
已经
很久
没有
和
下等人
说话
了！
感觉
真是
禁忌
又
刺激！

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Well adventurer, that's 
the end of our informal
chat. I'll even grant you
full permission to boast
of the fact that you've
spoken to Lady Satra.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
好了，冒险者，
我们的
非正式
闲聊
到此
结束。
我甚至
授予你
完全的
许可，
让你
可以
吹嘘
自己
曾
与
萨特拉
女士
交谈
过。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
If you do wish for
me to share words with
you once more, prove to
me that you're worthier
than the other peons of
my graceful presense.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
如果你
确实
希望
我
再次
与你
分享
言语，
那就
向我
证明
你
比
我
优雅
存在
下的
其他
杂役
更
有价值。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, I have a marvelous
idea! Why don't you bring
me ^990000Coals^000000? It's not impossible
for someone like yourself, but
this kind of task will require
some effort on your part.
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哦，我
有个
绝妙
的
主意！
你
为什么
不
给我
带
^990000煤^000000
呢？
对
你
这样
的
人
来说
并
不
不可能，
但
这种
任务
将
需要
你
付出
一些
努力。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Tah tah,
adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哒哒，
冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
A wandering
adventurer...?
How sinfully
intriguing!
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
流浪的
冒险者...？
真是
罪恶
又
迷人！
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, do not worry.
I'm sure the beauty of
my home has captured your
curiosity. My brutish excuse
for a husband would have you
beat if he found you...
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
哦，别
担心。
我
确信
我家
的
美丽
已经
俘获
了
你的
好奇心。
我
那个
粗鲁
的
丈夫
如果
发现
你...

scripts.text:
[Satra]
But I'm far more genteel
than Megass. You're more
than welcome to enjoy the
furnishings. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[萨特拉]
但
我
比
梅加斯
更
优雅。
你
完全
可以
享受
这里的
陈设。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
My son learned
an awful lot from
your good example.
As a mother, I really
appreciate everything
you've done for him.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
我
儿子
从
你
的
好
榜样
中
学到
了
很多。
作为
母亲，
我
真的
感激
你
为
他
做
的
一切。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Well, adventurer,
I will be praying for
your safety wherever
your journeys may
take you.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
好了，冒险者，
无论
你的
旅程
将
把你
带往
何处，
我
都会
为
你的
安全
祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Thank you for helping
my son Klitzer. Sadly, the
little fool doesn't have any
clue when it comes to certain
things like choosing clothing.
He gets so nervous about it!
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
谢谢
你
帮助
我
儿子
克利策。
可惜，
这个
小
傻瓜
在
某些
事情
上
完全
没有
概念，
比如
选择
衣服。
他
为此
非常
紧张！

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
A man should wear nice
clothes, like a Formal Suit
or a Tuxedo, for important
meetings and special occasions.
Hopefully, he'll learn that soon.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
男人
应该
穿
漂亮
的
衣服，
比如
西装外套
或
燕尾服，
用于
重要
的
会议
和
特殊
场合。
希望
他
很快
能
学到
这些。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Thank you for helping
my son Klitzer. Sadly, the
little fool doesn't have any
clue when it comes to certain
things like choosing clothing.
He gets so nervous about it!
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
谢谢
你
帮助
我
儿子
克利策。
可惜，
这个
小
傻瓜
在
某些
事情
上
完全
没有
概念，
比如
选择
衣服。
他
为此
非常
紧张！

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
A man should wear nice
clothes, like a Formal Suit
or a Tuxedo, for important
meetings and special occasions.
Hopefully, he'll learn that soon.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
男人
应该
穿
漂亮
的
衣服，
比如
西装外套
或
燕尾服，
用于
重要
的
会议
和
特殊
场合。
希望
他
很快
能
学到
这些。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
I can't bear to see the
petty hatred between our
two towns stop my son from
seeing the woman he loves...
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
我
无法
忍受
我们
两个
城镇
之间
的
小
仇恨
阻止
我
儿子
见到
他
爱
的
女人...

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Thank you for helping my
son. He may look like a fool
for falling in love with someone from Einbroch, but he's an honest
hard working man.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
谢谢
你
帮助
我
儿子。
他
可能
看起来
像个
傻瓜，
因为
爱上
了
来自
艾音布罗克
的
人，
但
他
是
一个
诚实
的
勤劳
的
男人。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Then again, it was bound to
happen sometime. Einbech is
a very poor town while Einbroch
is a very rich town. I'd understand if you don't agree, but opposites attract sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
不过，这种事迟早会发生。艾音贝赫是个非常贫穷的城镇，而艾音布罗克则非常富裕。如果你不同意，我也可以理解，但物极必反，早晚都会发生的。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
If my son and Calla can
work things out, maybe it
would improve relations
between our two towns.
I certainly hope so...
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
^666666*叹气...*^000000
如果我的儿子和卡拉能解决他们之间的问题，也许能改善我们两个城镇之间的关系。
我真心希望如此...

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Still, I'm quite baffled!
I raised my son to have more
guts than to wallow in misery
when his heart's broken. And
I still have no idea how he got together with such a rich woman.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
不过，我还是很困惑！
我把儿子培养得很有骨气，
即使心碎也不会沉浸在痛苦中。
而且，我仍然不知道他是怎么和那么富有的人在一起的。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Do you have any idea
how we can put an end
to the hate between our
two towns? I don't want to
see this couple separated
because of such pettiness.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
你有没有什么办法
能结束我们两个城镇之间的仇恨？
我不想看到这
对情侣因为这种小事而分开。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Welcome to my humble
abode, adventurer. I'm
sorry if I'm a poor host.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
欢迎来到我的简陋住所，冒险者。
如果我是个糟糕的主人，请见谅。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
As you can see, we have
to share this house with
other families so we don't
have much open space or
privacy. I'm afraid we can't
afford even basic comfort.
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
如您所见，我们不得不
与其他家庭共用这栋房子，
所以我们没有多少开放空间或隐私。
恐怕我们连基本的舒适都负担不起。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
For now, this is the best
we can do. We don't have
the zeny to buy a house or
land, so we have no choice
but to endure through this...
scripts.translation:
[凯杰塔]
目前，这是我们能做到的最好情况。
我们没有Zeny买房或买地，
所以只能忍受这种生活...

scripts.text:
[Keneshiotz]
This city is full of sky
high smokestacks and
the droning hum of machines.
scripts.translation:
[凯内希奥茨]
这座城市到处都是高耸的烟囱
和机器的轰鸣声。

scripts.text:
[Keneshiotz]
Sure, the air is polluted,
but I think it's a fair price
to pay for wealth and a
modern life of comfort.
Screw the environment!
scripts.translation:
[凯内希奥茨]
没错，空气被污染了，
但我觉得这是为了财富和
现代舒适生活所付出的合理代价。
去他的环境！

scripts.text:
[Keneshiotz]
I'd much rather live like
this than end up like those
backwards vagrants in that
filthy Einbech. Don't they
know that money makes
the world go 'round?
scripts.translation:
[凯内希奥茨]
我宁愿像这样生活，
也不愿像那些在肮脏的艾音贝赫
流浪的落后人一样。
他们难道不知道金钱
让世界运转吗？

scripts.text:
[Catzllanpu]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Simple pleasures.
They're what make
life worth living,
you know?
scripts.translation:
[卡茨兰普]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
简单的快乐。
你知道，正是这些
让生命值得过。

scripts.text:
[Catzllanpu]
It's enough for me just to
live a normal and happy life,
but everyone around me wants
to work harder and harder. If
you never take a rest, you're
killing yourself pretty slowly.
scripts.translation:
[卡茨兰普]
对我来说，
只要过正常而幸福的生活就够了，
但我周围的人
都想更努力地工作。
如果你从不休息，
你就是在慢慢地杀死自己。

scripts.text:
[Catzllanpu]
I guess you can tell that
I don't have the worries
other people have about
money. It's great, but it's
not worth sacrificing the
quality of your life, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡茨兰普]
我想你可以看出
我没有其他人
对金钱的担忧。
这很好，
但不值得牺牲
生活质量，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kesunboss]
Lady Calla is the
epitome of elegance,
a veritable goddess
of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[克孙博斯]
卡拉女士
是优雅的化身，
艾音布罗克真正的
女神。

scripts.text:
[Kesunboss]
Her gentle voice,
that angelic smile, her
kindness and warmth
towards other people
and above all...
scripts.translation:
[克孙博斯]
她温柔的声音，
那天使般的微笑，
她对别人的
善良和温暖，
最重要的是...

scripts.text:
[Kesunboss]
Calla's family
is wealthy beyond
imagination! She's
perfect! I don't know who
she'll marry, but he'd be
a lucky gentleman, I'm sure.
scripts.translation:
[克孙博斯]
卡拉的家族
富有得超乎想象！
她太完美了！我不知道
她会嫁给谁，
但我相信他一定是
一个幸运的绅士。

scripts.text:
[Kesunboss]
Lady Calla lives in a magnificent mansion that makes other houses
look like shacks in comparison.
Head north and then west from
here if you wish to marvel in its
beauty and elegance.
scripts.translation:
[克孙博斯]
卡拉女士住在一座宏伟的豪宅里，
相比之下，其他房子
看起来像棚屋。
如果你想欣赏它的美丽和优雅，
从这里向北，然后向西走。

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
Things might be
bad in this town
with the pollution
and the bullying
from Einbroch...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔亨杰]
这个城镇的情况可能
很糟糕，
有污染
和来自艾音布罗克的
欺凌...

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
But somehow, people
are able to get by. That's
because there's a guy
that everyone here likes...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔亨杰]
但不知怎的，
人们还是能过下去。
那是因为这里
有一个大家都喜欢的人...

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
I'm talking about Klitzer!
He's almost too honest and
almost too diligent. But most
of all, he's the nicest guy~
scripts.translation:
[艾尔亨杰]
我说的是克利策！
他几乎太诚实了，
几乎太勤奋了。
但最重要的是，
他是最善良的人~

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
Klitzer was born in one of
Einbech's poorest families,
but he's usually happy and always thinks about others. I guess that's why people like to think of him
as representing all of Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔亨杰]
克利策出生在艾音贝赫最贫穷的家庭之一，
但他通常都很快乐，总是为他人着想。
我想这就是为什么人们喜欢认为他代表了整个艾音贝赫。

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
Recently, something's
been bothering him. I'm
not sure, but I think only
woman troubles could make
a guy feel so glum. I hope he
feels better soon...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔亨杰]
最近，有些心事困扰着他。
我不确定，但我觉得只有女人的烦恼
才能让一个男人如此沮丧。
希望他能快点好起来...

scripts.text:
[Decii]
This is so
frustrating!
I'm surrounded
by all these ^FF0000people^000000!
scripts.translation:
[德西]
这太让人抓狂了！
我周围全是^FF0000人^000000！

scripts.text:
[Decii]
There's absolutely
no privacy in a city
this crowded! I guess
I should try to move
out as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[德西]
在这个拥挤的城市里，
完全没有隐私可言！
我想我应该尽快搬出去。

scripts.text:
[Supineque]
Ugh...
I'm starving!
scripts.translation:
[苏皮内克]
唉...
我饿死了！

scripts.text:
[Supineque]
I haven't had food for so
long that my stomach is
beginning to digest itself!
This is horrible...
scripts.translation:
[苏皮内克]
我已经很久没吃东西了，
我的胃开始消化自己了！
这太糟糕了...

scripts.text:
[Supineque]
I mean, I have
food that I can
eat today. But if
I finish it, what am
I gonna eat tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[苏皮内克]
我的意思是，我今天还有吃的。
但如果我吃光了，明天吃什么呢？
